```python
# explicit compatibility model used by server_v2/mobile.py
class NeutralWeatherCompatibilityV1(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)
    state: Literal["unavailable"] = "unavailable"
    source: Literal["compatibility_neutral"] = "compatibility_neutral"


class LiveRoundPackageV1Compatibility(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)
    schema: Literal["ai-caddie-live-round-package-v1"] = "ai-caddie-live-round-package-v1"
    liveRoundPackageId: str
    snapshotId: str
    courseLayoutIdentityId: str
    layoutRevisionId: str
    teeSelectionId: str
    playerBagSnapshot: dict
    roundPolicy: dict
    guidanceEngineBundle: dict
    minimumClients: dict
    personalization: dict | None
    weatherSnapshot: NeutralWeatherCompatibilityV1 = NeutralWeatherCompatibilityV1()


def serialize_live_round_package(package: LiveRoundPackageV2, *, schema_version: int) -> dict:
    if schema_version == 1:
        return LiveRoundPackageV1Compatibility(
            liveRoundPackageId=package.liveRoundPackageId,
            snapshotId=package.snapshotId,
            courseLayoutIdentityId=package.courseLayoutIdentityId,
            layoutRevisionId=package.layoutRevisionId,
            teeSelectionId=package.teeSelectionId,
            playerBagSnapshot=package.playerBagSnapshot,
            roundPolicy=package.roundPolicy,
            guidanceEngineBundle=package.guidanceEngineBundle,
            minimumClients=package.minimumClients,
            personalization=package.personalization,
        ).model_dump(mode="json")
    return package.model_dump(mode="json")
```

```python
# tests/test_round_ledger_repo.py
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from threading import Barrier

from sqlalchemy import select

from ai_caddie.rounds.ledger_repo import (
    LedgerRepository,
    validate_batch_receipt_roster,
)
from server_v2.db import reset_engine_for_tests, session_scope
from server_v2.ledger_db_models import LedgerPartitionRow, RoundEventRow


class RoundLedgerRepositoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        os.environ["AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL"] = f"sqlite:///{self.tmp.name}/ledger.db"
        self.addCleanup(os.environ.pop, "AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL", None)
        reset_engine_for_tests()
        self.repo = LedgerRepository.create_schema_for_tests()

    def test_event_identity_retry_returns_original_receipt(self) -> None:
        partition = self.repo.ensure_partition(owner="acct", subject_kind="round_incarnation", subject_id="inc-1", ledger_epoch=1, stream_id="stream-1")
        first = self.repo.append_event(partition, event_id="e1", event_identity="identity-e1", event_hash="h1", envelope_json='{"eventId":"e1"}', opaque=False)
        retry = self.repo.append_event(partition, event_id="e1", event_identity="identity-e1", event_hash="h1", envelope_json='{"eventId":"e1"}', opaque=False)
        self.assertEqual(retry.status, "duplicate_hash_match")
        self.assertEqual(retry.ledger_position, first.ledger_position)
        self.assertEqual(retry.ledger_partition_id, first.ledger_partition_id)

    def test_same_identity_with_different_hash_is_permanent_reject(self) -> None:
        partition = self.repo.ensure_partition(owner="acct", subject_kind="round_incarnation", subject_id="inc-1", ledger_epoch=1, stream_id="stream-1")
        self.repo.append_event(partition, event_id="e1", event_identity="identity-e1", event_hash="h1", envelope_json="{}", opaque=False)
        mismatch = self.repo.append_event(partition, event_id="e1", event_identity="identity-e1", event_hash="h2", envelope_json="{}", opaque=False)
        self.assertEqual(mismatch.status, "rejected_permanent")
        self.assertEqual(mismatch.reason_code, "identity_envelope_mismatch")

    def test_ack_is_partition_and_consumer_scoped_and_monotonic(self) -> None:
        partition = self.repo.ensure_partition(owner="acct", subject_kind="round_incarnation", subject_id="inc-ack", ledger_epoch=1, stream_id="stream-ack")
        for position in range(1, 9):
            self.repo.append_event(partition, event_id=f"e{position}", event_identity=f"identity-{position}", event_hash=f"h{position}", envelope_json="{}", opaque=False)
        self.assertEqual(self.repo.ack("acct", partition, "ios", "c1", 8), 8)
        self.assertEqual(self.repo.ack("acct", partition, "ios", "c1", 3), 8)
        self.assertEqual(self.repo.ack("acct", partition, "watch", "c1", 2), 2)

    def test_concurrent_first_ack_insert_uses_locked_retry_and_greatest_value(self) -> None:
        partition = self.repo.ensure_partition(owner="acct", subject_kind="round_incarnation", subject_id="inc-race", ledger_epoch=1, stream_id="stream-race")
        for position in range(1, 9):
            self.repo.append_event(partition, event_id=f"race-{position}", event_identity=f"race-identity-{position}", event_hash=f"race-hash-{position}", envelope_json="{}", opaque=False)
        barrier = Barrier(2)
        def acknowledge(position: int) -> int:
            barrier.wait(timeout=5)
            return LedgerRepository().ack("acct", partition, "ios", "epoch-1", position)
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
            values = [future.result(timeout=10) for future in [
                pool.submit(acknowledge, 3),
                pool.submit(acknowledge, 8),
            ]]
        self.assertIn(8, values)
        self.assertEqual(self.repo.ack("acct", partition, "ios", "epoch-1", 0), 8)

    def test_concurrent_append_assigns_unique_positions(self) -> None:
        partition = self.repo.ensure_partition(owner="acct", subject_kind="round_incarnation", subject_id="inc-append", ledger_epoch=1, stream_id="stream-append")
        barrier = Barrier(2)
        def append(index: int):
            barrier.wait(timeout=5)
            return LedgerRepository().append_event(
                partition,
                event_id=f"event-{index}", event_identity=f"identity-{index}",
                event_hash=f"hash-{index}", envelope_json="{}", opaque=False,
            )
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
            receipts = [future.result(timeout=10) for future in [
                pool.submit(append, 1),
                pool.submit(append, 2),
            ]]
        self.assertEqual({receipt.ledger_position for receipt in receipts}, {1, 2})
        with session_scope() as session:
            positions = session.scalars(
                select(RoundEventRow.ledger_position)
                .where(RoundEventRow.partition_id == partition)
                .order_by(RoundEventRow.ledger_position)
            ).all()
        self.assertEqual(positions, [1, 2])

    def test_concurrent_same_identity_has_one_row_and_one_duplicate_receipt(self) -> None:
        partition = self.repo.ensure_partition(owner="acct", subject_kind="round_incarnation", subject_id="inc-dedupe", ledger_epoch=1, stream_id="stream-dedupe")
        barrier = Barrier(2)
        def append_same():
            barrier.wait(timeout=5)
            return LedgerRepository().append_event(
                partition, event_id="same", event_identity="same-identity",
                event_hash="same-hash", envelope_json="{}", opaque=False,
            )
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
            receipts = [future.result(timeout=10) for future in [
                pool.submit(append_same), pool.submit(append_same),
            ]]
        self.assertEqual({receipt.status for receipt in receipts}, {"accepted", "duplicate_hash_match"})
        with session_scope() as session:
            count = len(session.scalars(
                select(RoundEventRow).where(RoundEventRow.event_identity == "same-identity")
            ).all())
        self.assertEqual(count, 1)

    def test_inactive_partition_ack_requires_bootstrap(self) -> None:
        partition = self.repo.ensure_partition(owner="acct", subject_kind="round_incarnation", subject_id="inc-inactive", ledger_epoch=1, stream_id="stream-inactive")
        with session_scope(sqlite_immediate=True) as session:
            session.get(LedgerPartitionRow, partition).active = False
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "bootstrap_required"):
            self.repo.ack("acct", partition, "ios", "epoch-1", 0)
```

```json
        },
        {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "required": ["kind", "mergeControlId"],
          "properties": {
            "kind": {"const": "merge_control"},
            "mergeControlId": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 128}
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    "ledgerEpoch": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[1-9][0-9]*$"},
    "streamId": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 128}
  }
}
```

把下面 entry 追加到 `canonical_object_registry.json.objects`，然后运行原有唯一 generator；Task 8 后续完整 registry table 必须保留此 entry 并继续引用本文件，不得重新声明 schema ownership：

```json
{
"LedgerPartitionId": {
  "domainTag": "LedgerPartitionId/v1",
  "schemaRef": "contracts/canonical/ledger_identity_v1.schema.json",
  "includedFields": ["ownerAccountId", "streamSubject", "ledgerEpoch", "streamId"],
  "excludedFields": ["ledgerPartitionId", "ledgerPosition"]
}
}
```

在 `test_canonical_contract_ids.py` 增加一个 positive round-incarnation fixture、一个 positive merge-control fixture，以及 `ledgerEpoch: 1`（JSON integer）、`"01"`、双 subject ID、额外 `ledgerPosition` 四个 schema-invalid negative cases；`test_contract_codegen.py` 断言三个 outputs 同时包含 `LedgerPartitionId/v1`。运行 generator 后才继续创建下列 SQL tables。

```python
# ai_caddie/rounds/ledger_repo.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from uuid import uuid4

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ai_caddie.contracts.typed_ids import typed_id
from server_v2.db import get_engine, session_scope
from server_v2.ledger_db_models import (
    ConsumerAckRow,
    EventDeadLetterRow,
    EventReceiptRow,
    LedgerBase,
    LedgerPartitionRow,
    RoundBranchBindingRow,
    RoundEventRow,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StoredReceipt:
    event_id: str | None
    event_identity: str | None
    event_hash: str | None
    input_index: int
    status: str
    ledger_partition_id: str | None
    ledger_epoch: int | None
    stream_id: str | None
    ledger_position: int | None
    current_entity_revision: dict[str, object] | None = None
    reason_code: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "eventId": self.event_id,
            "eventIdentity": self.event_identity,
            "eventHash": self.event_hash,
            "inputIndex": self.input_index,
            "status": self.status,
            "ledgerPartitionId": self.ledger_partition_id,
            "ledgerEpoch": self.ledger_epoch,
            "streamId": self.stream_id,
            "ledgerPosition": None if self.ledger_position is None else str(self.ledger_position),
            "currentEntityRevision": self.current_entity_revision,
            "reasonCode": self.reason_code,
        }


class LedgerRepository:
    @classmethod
    def create_schema_for_tests(cls) -> "LedgerRepository":
        LedgerBase.metadata.create_all(get_engine())
        return cls()

    def ack(self, owner: str, partition: str, device: str, epoch: str, position: int) -> int:
        for attempt in range(2):
            try:
                with session_scope(sqlite_immediate=True) as session:
                    partition_row = session.scalar(
                        select(LedgerPartitionRow).where(
                            LedgerPartitionRow.id == partition,
                            LedgerPartitionRow.owner_account_id == owner,
                            LedgerPartitionRow.active.is_(True),
                        ).with_for_update()
                    )
                    if partition_row is None:
                        raise ValueError("bootstrap_required")
                    if position > partition_row.next_position - 1:
                        raise ValueError("consumer_ack_ahead_of_stream")
                    row = session.scalar(
                        select(ConsumerAckRow).where(
                            ConsumerAckRow.owner_account_id == owner,
                            ConsumerAckRow.partition_id == partition,
                            ConsumerAckRow.consumer_device_id == device,
                            ConsumerAckRow.consumer_epoch == epoch,
                        ).with_for_update()
                    )
                    if row is None:
                        row = ConsumerAckRow(
                            owner_account_id=owner,
                            partition_id=partition,
                            consumer_device_id=device,
                            consumer_epoch=epoch,
                            ledger_position=position,
                        )
                        session.add(row)
                    else:
                        row.ledger_position = max(row.ledger_position, position)
                    session.flush()
                    return row.ledger_position
            except IntegrityError:
                if attempt == 1:
                    raise
        raise AssertionError("unreachable")

    def ensure_partition(self, *, owner: str, subject_kind: str, subject_id: str, ledger_epoch: int, stream_id: str) -> str:
        subject_key = "roundIncarnationId" if subject_kind == "round_incarnation" else "mergeControlId"
        identity = {
            "ownerAccountId": owner,
            "streamSubject": {"kind": subject_kind, subject_key: subject_id},
            "ledgerEpoch": str(ledger_epoch),
            "streamId": stream_id,
        }
        partition_id = typed_id("LedgerPartitionId/v1", identity)
        with session_scope(sqlite_immediate=True) as session:
            if session.get(LedgerPartitionRow, partition_id) is None:
                session.add(LedgerPartitionRow(
                    id=partition_id, owner_account_id=owner, stream_subject_kind=subject_kind,
                    stream_subject_id=subject_id, ledger_epoch=ledger_epoch, stream_id=stream_id,
                    next_position=1, active=True,
                ))
        return partition_id

    @staticmethod
    def _stored(
        row: EventReceiptRow,
        *,
        status: str | None = None,
        reason: str | None = None,
        input_index_override: int | None = None,
    ) -> StoredReceipt:
        return StoredReceipt(
            event_id=row.event_id,
            event_identity=row.event_identity,
            event_hash=row.event_hash,
            input_index=row.input_index if input_index_override is None else input_index_override,
            status=status or row.status,
            ledger_partition_id=row.partition_id,
            ledger_epoch=row.ledger_epoch,
            stream_id=row.stream_id,
            ledger_position=row.ledger_position,
            current_entity_revision=None,
            reason_code=reason if reason is not None else row.reason_code,
        )

    def append_event(self, partition_id: str, *, event_id: str, event_identity: str, event_hash: str, envelope_json: str, opaque: bool, input_index: int = 0) -> StoredReceipt:
        for attempt in range(2):
            try:
                with session_scope(sqlite_immediate=True) as session:
                    existing = session.scalar(
                        select(EventReceiptRow).where(EventReceiptRow.event_identity == event_identity)
                    )
                    if existing is not None:
                        if existing.event_hash != event_hash:
                            return self._stored(
                                existing,
                                status="rejected_permanent",
                                reason="identity_envelope_mismatch",
                                input_index_override=input_index,
                            )
                        return self._stored(
                            existing,
                            status="duplicate_hash_match",
                            input_index_override=input_index,
                        )
                    partition = session.scalar(
                        select(LedgerPartitionRow)
                        .where(LedgerPartitionRow.id == partition_id, LedgerPartitionRow.active.is_(True))
                        .with_for_update()
                    )
                    if partition is None:
                        raise ValueError("bootstrap_required")
                    position = partition.next_position
                    partition.next_position += 1
                    status = "accepted_opaque" if opaque else "accepted"
                    session.add(RoundEventRow(
                        partition_id=partition_id, ledger_position=position, event_identity=event_identity,
                        event_hash=event_hash, envelope_json=envelope_json, opaque=opaque,
                    ))
                    receipt = EventReceiptRow(
                        receipt_key=event_identity, event_identity=event_identity, event_id=event_id,
                        event_hash=event_hash, input_index=input_index, status=status,
                        partition_id=partition_id, ledger_epoch=partition.ledger_epoch, stream_id=partition.stream_id,
                        ledger_position=position, current_entity_revision_json=None, reason_code=None,
                    )
                    session.add(receipt)
                    session.flush()
                    return self._stored(receipt)
            except IntegrityError:
                if attempt == 1:
                    raise
        raise AssertionError("unreachable")

```

- [ ] **Step 5: 实现 SQLite immediate write transaction 并通过 barrier concurrency tests**

把 `server_v2/db.py` 的 `session_scope` 完整替换为带显式 opt-in 的版本；read path 保持 deferred transaction，只有 repository mutation 使用 `sqlite_immediate=True`：

```python
# server_v2/db.py
@contextmanager
def session_scope(*, sqlite_immediate: bool = False) -> Iterator[Session]:
    """Transactional session; SQLite ledger writes acquire the writer lock before reading."""
    session = _session_factory()()
    try:
        if sqlite_immediate:
            bind = session.get_bind()
            if bind.dialect.name == "sqlite":
                session.connection().exec_driver_sql("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        yield session
        session.commit()
    except Exception:
        session.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        session.close()
```

上面完整给出的 `ack()`、`ensure_partition()` 与 `append_event()` method body 已直接使用 `session_scope(sqlite_immediate=True)`；纯 replay/list 继续使用默认 `session_scope()`。Task 8/10 新增的 reserve、reject/dead-letter、merge 与 compaction mutation 在各自完整 method 中也必须显式传同一 flag。禁止在 helper 内全局启用 `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`，否则 identity/read endpoints 会无谓抢 writer lock。PostgreSQL 忽略该 flag，并继续依赖每个 method 已给出的 `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`。Step 1 的两个 `Barrier(2)` append tests 与 ACK test 必须在未加 flag 时至少一个复现 lost update/`database is locked`，加 flag 后稳定 PASS；inactive partition 仍返回 `bootstrap_required`。

Run:

```bash
uv run python tools/contracts/generate_contracts.py
uv run python -m unittest tests.test_canonical_contract_ids tests.test_contract_codegen -v
uv run alembic upgrade head
uv run python -m unittest tests.test_round_ledger_repo tests.test_identity_migration tests.test_identity_migration_0002 -v
```

Expected: PASS; barrier threads 全部完成、positions 为 `[1, 2]`、same identity 只有一行、ACK durable maximum 为 `8`，migration 在 fresh SQLite 和现有 0002 后均成功。

```python
    def test_concurrent_terminal_completion_rebuilds_one_canonical_response(self) -> None:
        body = canonical_json_bytes({
            "events": [fixture_event("completion-race", "hole_score_set", sequence=12)],
        })
        barrier = Barrier(2)

        def post() -> bytes:
            barrier.wait(timeout=5)
            response = TestClient(app).post(
                f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events",
                content=body,
                headers={
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "Idempotency-Key": "terminal-race",
                    "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1",
                },
            )
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
            return response.content

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
            returned = [future.result(timeout=10) for future in (
                executor.submit(post), executor.submit(post),
            )]
        self.assertEqual(returned[0], returned[1])
        payload = parse_unique_json(returned[0])
        self.assertEqual(payload["schema"], "ai-caddie-event-write-response-v2")
        self.assertEqual(payload["eventCount"], 1)
        # accepted/duplicate_hash_match are two observations of one durable row;
        # the cached response is rebuilt from that row and therefore byte-identical.
        self.assertEqual(payload["receipts"][0]["status"], "accepted")

            owner_account_id="acct-1", round_id=ROUND_ID, request_key="raw-byte-key",
            request_hash="same-semantic-hash", request_body=compact,
            request_body_sha256=sha256(compact).hexdigest(),
            request_body_bytes=len(compact),
        ))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "idempotency_key_body_mismatch"):
            self.repo.reserve_batch(
                owner_account_id="acct-1", round_id=ROUND_ID,
                request_key="raw-byte-key", request_hash="same-semantic-hash",
                request_body=spaced, request_body_sha256=sha256(spaced).hexdigest(),
                request_body_bytes=len(spaced),
            )
```

```python
# tests/test_round_ingest_limits.py
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
import asyncio
from base64 import urlsafe_b64decode, urlsafe_b64encode
from hashlib import sha256
import re

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import select

from ai_caddie.contracts.typed_ids import typed_id
from ai_caddie.rounds.ledger_limits import (
    MAX_EVENTS_PER_BATCH,
    MAX_HTTP_BODY_BYTES,
    round_event_batch_hash,
)
from ai_caddie.rounds.ledger_repo import LedgerRepository
from server_v2.account_context import current_account_context
from server_v2.db import reset_engine_for_tests, session_scope
from server_v2.ledger_db_models import BatchRequestRow, EventDeadLetterRow
from server_v2.main import app
from server_v2.request_limits import RoundLedgerRequestLimitMiddleware
from server_v2.round_ledger_api import get_ledger_repo
from tests.test_round_event_ingest_v2 import ROUND_ID, fixture_event
from tests.device_request_fixtures import account_context_fixture


class RoundIngestLimitTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        os.environ["AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL"] = f"sqlite:///{self.tmp.name}/limits.db"
        self.addCleanup(os.environ.pop, "AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL", None)
        reset_engine_for_tests()
        self.repo = LedgerRepository.create_schema_for_tests()
        self.repo.seed_round_binding_for_tests(
            owner_account_id="acct-1",
            round_id=ROUND_ID,
            round_incarnation_id="inc-1",
            round_intent_id="intent-1",
            snapshot_id="snapshot-ok",
            semantic_binding_hash="binding-1",
        )
        app.dependency_overrides[get_ledger_repo] = lambda: self.repo
        app.dependency_overrides[current_account_context] = account_context_fixture
        self.addCleanup(app.dependency_overrides.clear)
        self.client = TestClient(app)

    def test_batch_hash_matches_typed_id_for_valid_input(self) -> None:
        events = [fixture_event("hash", "future_kind", sequence=1)]
        self.assertEqual(
            round_event_batch_hash(ROUND_ID, events),
            typed_id("RoundEventBatch/v1", {"roundId": ROUND_ID, "events": events}),
        )

    def test_batch_count_limit_rejects_before_reservation(self) -> None:
        events = [
            fixture_event(f"too-many-{index}", "future_kind", sequence=index + 1)
            for index in range(MAX_EVENTS_PER_BATCH + 1)
        ]
        response = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events",
            json={"events": events},
            headers={"Idempotency-Key": "too-many", "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 413)
        self.assertEqual(response.json()["detail"]["reasonCode"], "event_batch_too_large")
        with session_scope() as session:
            self.assertEqual(session.query(BatchRequestRow).count(), 0)

    def test_path_and_idempotency_key_lengths_fail_before_storage(self) -> None:
        event = fixture_event("bounds", "future_kind", sequence=1)
        too_long_path = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{'a' * 200}/events",
            json={"events": [event]},
            headers={"Idempotency-Key": "valid", "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(too_long_path.status_code, 422)
        too_long_key = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events",
            json={"events": [event]},
            headers={"Idempotency-Key": "k" * 129, "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(too_long_key.status_code, 422)
        with session_scope() as session:
            self.assertEqual(session.query(BatchRequestRow).count(), 0)
            self.assertEqual(session.query(EventDeadLetterRow).count(), 0)

    def test_invalid_batch_shape_does_not_poison_later_valid_same_key(self) -> None:
        headers = {"Idempotency-Key": "shape-retry", "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1"}
        invalid = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events",
            json={"events": {}},
            headers=headers,
        )
        self.assertEqual(invalid.status_code, 422)
        valid = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events",
            json={"events": [fixture_event("shape-valid", "future_kind", sequence=1)]},
            headers=headers,
        )
        self.assertEqual(valid.json()["receipts"][0]["status"], "accepted_opaque")

    def test_event_limit_is_per_event_and_large_dead_letter_is_hash_only(self) -> None:
        accepted = fixture_event("at-limit", "future_kind", sequence=1)
        accepted["payload"] = {"futureField": "x" * 4_096}
        oversized = fixture_event("over-limit", "future_kind", sequence=2)
        oversized["payload"] = {"futureField": "y" * 70_000}
        response = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events",
            json={"events": [accepted, oversized]},
            headers={"Idempotency-Key": "per-event-limit", "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            [row["status"] for row in response.json()["receipts"]],
            ["accepted_opaque", "rejected_permanent"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            response.json()["receipts"][1]["reasonCode"],
            "event_envelope_limit_exceeded",
        )
        with session_scope() as session:
            dead_letter = session.scalar(select(EventDeadLetterRow))
            self.assertIsNotNone(dead_letter)
            self.assertTrue(dead_letter.diagnostic_event_truncated)
            self.assertGreater(dead_letter.diagnostic_event_bytes, 16_384)
            retained = json.loads(dead_letter.diagnostic_event_json)
            self.assertEqual(
                retained["diagnosticEventSha256"],
                dead_letter.diagnostic_event_sha256,
            )

    def test_per_event_depth_limit_is_a_durable_reject(self) -> None:
        nested: object = "leaf"
        for _ in range(20):
            nested = {"next": nested}
        event = fixture_event("deep-event", "future_kind", sequence=3)
        event["payload"] = {"futureField": nested}
        receipt = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events",
            json={"events": [event]},
            headers={"Idempotency-Key": "deep-event", "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1"},
        ).json()["receipts"][0]
        self.assertEqual(
            (receipt["status"], receipt["reasonCode"]),
            ("rejected_permanent", "event_envelope_limit_exceeded"),
        )

        long_id = fixture_event("x" * 129, "future_kind", sequence=4)
        long_receipt = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events",
            json={"events": [long_id]},
            headers={"Idempotency-Key": "long-field", "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1"},
        ).json()["receipts"][0]
        self.assertEqual(long_receipt["reasonCode"], "event_envelope_limit_exceeded")

    def test_noncanonical_values_are_durable_per_event_rejects_not_500(self) -> None:
        cases = []
        too_large_integer = fixture_event("huge-int", "future_kind", sequence=1)
        too_large_integer["clientSequence"] = 9_007_199_254_740_992
        cases.append(too_large_integer)
        negative_zero = fixture_event("negative-zero", "future_kind", sequence=2)
        negative_zero["payload"] = {"futureField": -0.0}
        cases.append(negative_zero)
        decomposed_value = fixture_event("decomposed-value", "future_kind", sequence=3)
        decomposed_value["payload"] = {"futureField": "e\u0301"}
        cases.append(decomposed_value)
        decomposed_key = fixture_event("decomposed-key", "future_kind", sequence=4)
        decomposed_key["payload"] = {"e\u0301": "value"}
        cases.append(decomposed_key)

        body = {"events": cases}
        headers = {
            "Idempotency-Key": "canonical-value-bombs",
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1",
        }
        first = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events",
            json=body,
            headers=headers,
        )
        self.assertEqual(first.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(
            [(row["status"], row["reasonCode"]) for row in first.json()["receipts"]],
            [("rejected_permanent", "event_envelope_limit_exceeded")] * 4,
        )
        retry = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events",
            json=body,
            headers=headers,
        )
        self.assertEqual(retry.json(), first.json())
        with session_scope() as session:
            self.assertEqual(session.query(EventDeadLetterRow).count(), 4)

    def test_duplicate_keys_and_unknown_batch_fields_reject_before_reservation(self) -> None:
        path = f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events"
        headers = {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Idempotency-Key": "strict-transport-json",
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1",
        }
        duplicate = self.client.post(
            path,
            content=b'{"events":[],"events":[]}',
            headers=headers,
        )
        self.assertEqual(duplicate.status_code, 422)
        extra = self.client.post(
            path,
            content=b'{"events":[],"debug":true}',
            headers=headers,
        )
        self.assertEqual(extra.status_code, 422)
        valid = self.client.post(
            path,
            content=b'{"events":[]}',
            headers=headers,
        )
        self.assertEqual(valid.status_code, 200)
        with session_scope() as session:
            row = session.scalar(select(BatchRequestRow))
            self.assertIsNotNone(row)
            self.assertEqual(row.request_body_sha256, sha256(b'{"events":[]}').hexdigest())
            self.assertEqual(row.request_body_bytes, len(b'{"events":[]}'))
            self.assertEqual(row.request_body, b'{"events":[]}')
            self.assertIsNotNone(row.response_body)
            self.assertEqual(sha256(row.response_body).hexdigest(), row.response_sha256)
            self.assertEqual(session.query(EventDeadLetterRow).count(), 0)

    def test_dead_letter_quota_and_cursor_bound_storage_and_read_amplification(self) -> None:
        path = f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events"
        for batch_index in range(32):
            events = []
            for item in range(64):
                event = fixture_event(
                    f"quota-{batch_index}-{item}",
                    "hole_score_set",
                    sequence=batch_index * 64 + item + 1,
                )
                event["payload"] = {"strokes": 4}
                events.append(event)
            response = self.client.post(
                path,
                json={"events": events},
                headers={
                    "Idempotency-Key": f"quota-{batch_index}",
                    "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1",
                },
            )
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        overflow_event = fixture_event("quota-overflow", "hole_score_set", sequence=99999)
        overflow_event["payload"] = {"strokes": 4}
        overflow = self.client.post(
            path,
            json={"events": [overflow_event]},
            headers={
                "Idempotency-Key": "quota-overflow",
                "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1",
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(overflow.status_code, 429)
        self.assertEqual(overflow.json(), {"code": "dead_letter_quota_exceeded"})
        page = self.client.get(
            f"{path.rsplit('/events', 1)[0]}/dead-letters?limit=100",
            headers={"X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(page.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(page.json()["deadLetters"]), 100)
        self.assertIsNotNone(page.json()["nextCursor"])
        with session_scope() as session:
            self.assertEqual(session.query(EventDeadLetterRow).count(), 2048)

    def test_http_byte_and_json_depth_limits_return_413_without_rows(self) -> None:
        headers = {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Idempotency-Key": "body-limit",
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1",
        }
        too_large = json.dumps({"events": [], "padding": "z" * MAX_HTTP_BODY_BYTES})
        response = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events",
            content=too_large,
            headers=headers,
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 413)
        nested: object = "leaf"
        for _ in range(70):
            nested = [nested]
        deep = self.client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{ROUND_ID}/events",
            content=json.dumps({"events": [nested]}),
            headers={**headers, "Idempotency-Key": "depth-limit"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(deep.status_code, 413)
        with session_scope() as session:
            self.assertEqual(session.query(BatchRequestRow).count(), 0)
            self.assertEqual(session.query(EventDeadLetterRow).count(), 0)

    def test_streaming_limit_catches_chunked_and_lying_content_length(self) -> None:
        async def run(chunks: list[bytes], declared: str | None) -> list[dict]:
            seen: list[dict] = []
            index = 0

            async def receive() -> dict:
                nonlocal index
                if index == len(chunks):
                    return {"type": "http.disconnect"}
                body = chunks[index]
                index += 1
                return {
                    "type": "http.request",
                    "body": body,
                    "more_body": index < len(chunks),
                }

            async def send(message: dict) -> None:
                seen.append(message)

            async def app_that_reads(scope: dict, receive, send) -> None:
                while True:
                    message = await receive()
                    if not message.get("more_body"):
                        break
                await send({
                    "type": "http.response.start", "status": 200, "headers": [],
                })
                await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": b"ok"})

            headers = [(b"content-type", b"application/json")]
            if declared is not None:
                headers.append((b"content-length", declared.encode("ascii")))
            middleware = RoundLedgerRequestLimitMiddleware(
                app_that_reads, maximum_body_bytes=10,
            )
            await middleware(
                {"type": "http", "path": "/api/v2/round-ledger/" + "a" * 36 + "/events", "headers": headers},
                receive,
                send,
            )
            return seen

        chunked = asyncio.run(run([b"{\"events\":", b"[]}" + b"x" * 20], None))
        lying = asyncio.run(run([b"x" * 20], "1"))
        for messages in (chunked, lying):
            self.assertEqual(messages[0]["status"], 413)
```

```python
# tests/test_device_request_auth.py
from __future__ import annotations

from base64 import urlsafe_b64encode
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PrivateKey
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from ai_caddie.contracts.canonical_json import canonical_json_bytes, parse_unique_json
from ai_caddie.contracts.typed_ids import typed_id
from server_v2.account_context import (
    AccountContext,
    current_account_context,
    get_device_request_authenticator,
)
from server_v2.device_credential import (
    DeviceCredentialRecord,
    DeviceProofFailure,
    DeviceRequestAuthenticator,
    DeviceRequestProof,
    Ed25519DeviceCredentialVerifier,
    InvalidDeviceProof,
    invalid_device_proof_handler,
)


NOW = datetime(2026, 7, 18, 12, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


class MemoryCredentialRepo:
    def __init__(self, record: DeviceCredentialRecord) -> None:
        self.record = record
        self.lookups = 0

    def get_by_id(self, credential_id: str) -> DeviceCredentialRecord | None:
        self.lookups += 1
        return self.record if credential_id == self.record.credential_id else None


class MemoryNonceRepo:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.values: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()

    def consume_once(
        self,
        *,
        credential_id: str,
        nonce_hash: str,
        request_proof_hash: str,
        issued_at: datetime,
        expires_at: datetime,
        accepted_at: datetime,
    ) -> None:
        key = (credential_id, nonce_hash)
        if key in self.values:
            raise InvalidDeviceProof(DeviceProofFailure.NONCE_REPLAY)
        self.values.add(key)


class DeviceRequestAuthTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.private_key = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
        public_spki = self.private_key.public_key().public_bytes(
            serialization.Encoding.DER,
            serialization.PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo,
        )
        self.record = DeviceCredentialRecord(
            credential_id="credential-ios-1",
            account_id="acct-1",
            player_id="player-1",
            security_domain_id="security-acct-1",
            device_id="ios-1",
            platform="ios",
            algorithm="Ed25519",
            public_key_spki=public_spki,
            public_key_spki_sha256=sha256(public_spki).hexdigest(),
            attestation_kind="app_attest",
            attestation_evidence_hash="b" * 64,
            generation=1,
            status="active",
            enrolled_at=NOW - timedelta(days=1),
            not_before=NOW - timedelta(days=1),
            expires_at=NOW + timedelta(days=30),
            revoked_at=None,
        )
        self.credentials = MemoryCredentialRepo(self.record)
        self.nonces = MemoryNonceRepo()
        self.authenticator = DeviceRequestAuthenticator(
            credential_repo=self.credentials,
            verifier=Ed25519DeviceCredentialVerifier(),
            nonce_repo=self.nonces,
            clock=lambda: NOW,
        )
        app = FastAPI()
        app.add_exception_handler(InvalidDeviceProof, invalid_device_proof_handler)

        @app.post("/probe")
        async def probe(
            body: dict,
            account: AccountContext = Depends(current_account_context),
        ) -> dict:
            return {
                "accountId": account.account_id,
                "playerId": account.subject_player_id,
                "deviceId": account.device_id,
                "credentialId": account.device_principal.credential_id,
                "body": body,
            }

        app.dependency_overrides[get_device_request_authenticator] = (
            lambda: self.authenticator
        )
        self.client = TestClient(app)
        self.identity_patch = patch(
            "server_v2.account_context.resolve_request_identity",
            return_value=("player-1", "session-1"),
        )
        self.account_patch = patch(
            "server_v2.account_context._resolve_or_create_account",
            return_value="acct-1",
        )
        self.identity_patch.start()
        self.account_patch.start()
        self.addCleanup(self.identity_patch.stop)
        self.addCleanup(self.account_patch.stop)

    def signed_headers(
        self,
        body: bytes,
        *,
        nonce_byte: int,
        routing_device_id: str = "ios-1",
        target: str = "/probe?a=1&b=2",
        account_id: str = "acct-1",
    ) -> dict[str, str]:
        nonce = bytes([nonce_byte]) * 32
        nonce_text = urlsafe_b64encode(nonce).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")
        issued_at = "2026-07-18T12:00:00.000Z"
        content_hash = sha256(body).hexdigest()
        proof = DeviceRequestProof(
            schema="ai-caddie-device-request-proof-v1",
            audience="round-ledger-v2",
            credentialId=self.record.credential_id,
            accountId=account_id,
            method="POST",
            target=target,
            contentSha256=content_hash,
            nonce=nonce_text,
            issuedAt=issued_at,
        )
        signature = self.private_key.sign(
            b"DeviceRequestProof/v1\0" + canonical_json_bytes(proof.as_dict())
        )
        return {
            "Authorization": "Bearer player-token",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": routing_device_id,
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-Credential-ID": self.record.credential_id,
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-Nonce": nonce_text,
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-Issued-At": issued_at,
            "X-AI-Caddie-Content-SHA256": content_hash,
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-Signature": (
                urlsafe_b64encode(signature).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")
            ),
        }

    def post(self, body: bytes, headers: dict[str, str]):
        return self.client.post("/probe?b=2&a=1", content=body, headers=headers)

    def assert_invalid(self, response) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 401)
        self.assertEqual(response.json(), {"code": "invalid_device_proof"})

    def test_valid_proof_derives_canonical_device_from_credential(self) -> None:
        body = b'{"value":1}'
        response = self.post(body, self.signed_headers(body, nonce_byte=1))
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(
            response.json(),
            {
                "accountId": "acct-1",
                "playerId": "player-1",
                "deviceId": "ios-1",
                "credentialId": "credential-ios-1",
                "body": {"value": 1},
            },
        )

    def test_spoofed_routing_hint_does_not_consume_nonce(self) -> None:
        body = b'{"value":2}'
        headers = self.signed_headers(
            body, nonce_byte=2, routing_device_id="watch-victim",
        )
        self.assert_invalid(self.post(body, headers))
        headers["X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID"] = "ios-1"
        self.assertEqual(self.post(body, headers).status_code, 200)

    def test_body_hash_mismatch_does_not_consume_nonce(self) -> None:
        good = b'{"value":3}'
        headers = self.signed_headers(good, nonce_byte=3)
        self.assert_invalid(self.post(b'{"value":4}', headers))
        self.assertEqual(self.post(good, headers).status_code, 200)

    def test_nonce_replay_is_uniform_401(self) -> None:
        body = b'{"value":5}'
        headers = self.signed_headers(body, nonce_byte=4)
        self.assertEqual(self.post(body, headers).status_code, 200)
        self.assert_invalid(self.post(body, headers))

    def test_oversized_header_rejects_before_credential_lookup(self) -> None:
        body = b'{"value":6}'
        headers = self.signed_headers(body, nonce_byte=5)
        before = self.credentials.lookups
        headers["X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID"] = "x" * 129
        self.assert_invalid(self.post(body, headers))
        self.assertEqual(self.credentials.lookups, before)

    def test_bearer_account_mismatch_does_not_consume_nonce(self) -> None:
        body = b'{"value":7}'
        headers = self.signed_headers(body, nonce_byte=6)
        with patch(
            "server_v2.account_context._resolve_or_create_account",
            return_value="acct-other",
        ):
            self.assert_invalid(self.post(body, headers))
        self.assertEqual(self.post(body, headers).status_code, 200)
```

该测试必须使用真实 `LedgerRepository` 与真实 payload/subject validator；禁止 dependency override 到 `FakeRepo` 或手写 receipt。每个 input 都保留 `inputIndex`，单条 `model_validate`/payload/binding failure 只产生该条的 durable reject，不中止 batch。

```python
# tests/test_round_start_binding.py
from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from threading import Barrier

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Integer, String, Text, UniqueConstraint, select

class TestRoundStartAuthorityRow(LedgerBase):
    __tablename__ = "test_round_start_authority"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    owner_account_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=False)
    security_domain_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=False)
    device_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=False)
    credential_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(128), nullable=False)
    install_ack_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    static_authority_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    effective_control_hash: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=False)
    mode: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False)
    active: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    __table_args__ = (UniqueConstraint(
        "owner_account_id", "device_id", "install_ack_id",
        name="uq_test_round_start_authority",
    ),)


class SQLiteRoundStartBindingAuthority:
    def verify_in_session(
        self,
        session: Session,
        *,
        principal,
        request: RoundStartAuthorityRequest,
    ) -> VerifiedRoundDeviceInstallBinding:
        row = session.scalar(
            select(TestRoundStartAuthorityRow)
            .where(
                TestRoundStartAuthorityRow.owner_account_id == principal.account_id,
                TestRoundStartAuthorityRow.device_id == principal.device_id,
                TestRoundStartAuthorityRow.install_ack_id == request.install_ack_id,
            )
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if row is None:
            raise RoundStartAuthorityRejected(RoundStartRejectReason.INSTALL_ACK_MISSING)
        if row.mode == "unavailable":
            raise RoundStartAuthorityUnavailable
        if not row.active:
            raise RoundStartAuthorityRejected(
                RoundStartRejectReason.INSTALL_ACK_NOT_VERIFIED,
            )
        return VerifiedRoundDeviceInstallBinding(
            account_id=principal.account_id,
            security_domain_id=principal.security_domain_id,
            device_id=principal.device_id,
            credential_id=principal.credential_id,
            round_id=request.round_id,
            round_intent_id=request.round_intent_id,
            round_incarnation_id=request.round_incarnation_id,
            install_ack_id=request.install_ack_id,
            install_ack_generation=1,
            install_instance_id=request.install_instance_id,
            install_manifest_id=request.install_manifest_id,
            snapshot_id=request.snapshot_id,
            profile_id=request.profile_id,
            course_layout_identity_id=request.course_layout_identity_id,
            layout_revision_id=request.layout_revision_id,
            tee_selection_id=request.tee_selection_id,
            live_round_package_id=request.live_round_package_id,
            semantic_binding_hash=request.semantic_binding_hash,
            event_identity=request.event_identity,
            event_hash=request.event_hash,
            canonical_event_bytes_sha256=request.canonical_event_bytes_sha256,
            start_verified_at=request.start_verified_at,
            static_authority_hash=row.static_authority_hash,
            effective_control_hash=row.effective_control_hash,
            device_pin_generation=1,
            control_generation=1,
            authority_verified_at="2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z",
        )


class RoundStartBindingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    account = account_context_fixture()

    def open_database(self) -> tempfile.TemporaryDirectory[str]:
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        os.environ["AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL"] = f"sqlite:///{temporary.name}/ledger.db"
        reset_engine_for_tests()
        return temporary

    @staticmethod
    def semantic_binding(snapshot_id: str = "snapshot-ok") -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "snapshotId": snapshot_id,
            "courseLayoutIdentityId": "layout-1",
            "layoutRevisionId": "layout-r1",
            "teeSelectionId": "tee-1",
            "liveRoundPackageId": "lrp-1",
        }

    @classmethod
    def start_event(
        cls,
        *,
        round_id: str,
        event_id: str = "start-1",
        round_intent_id: str = "intent-1",
        round_incarnation_id: str = "inc-1",
        snapshot_id: str = "snapshot-ok",
        semantic_binding_hash: str | None = None,
        device_id: str = "ios-1",
    ) -> RoundEventEnvelopeV2:
        semantic = cls.semantic_binding(snapshot_id)
        return RoundEventEnvelopeV2.model_validate({
            "eventId": event_id,
            "originDeviceId": device_id,
            "originEpoch": "boot-1",
            "clientSequence": 1,
            "ownerAccountId": "acct-1",
            "subjectPlayerId": "player-1",
            "actorId": "player-1",
            "roundId": round_id,
            "streamSubject": {
                "kind": "round_incarnation",
                "roundIncarnationId": round_incarnation_id,
            },
            "roundIntentId": round_intent_id,
            "snapshotId": snapshot_id,
            "roundSemanticBindingHash": semantic_binding_hash
            or typed_id("RoundSemanticBinding/v1", semantic),
            "occurredAt": "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z",
            "kind": "round_started",
            "entityRef": f"round:{round_id}",
            "payload": {"deviceRoundInstallBinding": {
                "deviceId": device_id,
                "installAckId": "c" * 64,
                "installInstanceId": "install-instance-1",
                "installManifestId": "manifest-1",
                "snapshotId": snapshot_id,
                "profileId": "ios-v1",
                "courseLayoutIdentityId": "layout-1",
                "layoutRevisionId": "layout-r1",
                "teeSelectionId": "tee-1",
                "liveRoundPackageId": "lrp-1",
                "verifiedAt": "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z",
            }},
            "causationId": None,
            "baseEntityRevision": None,
            "schemaVersion": 2,
        })

    @classmethod
    def seed_authority(
        cls,
        event: RoundEventEnvelopeV2,
        *,
        mode: str = "active",
    ) -> None:
        binding = event.payload["deviceRoundInstallBinding"]
        assert isinstance(binding, dict)
        with session_scope(sqlite_immediate=True) as session:
            session.add(TestRoundStartAuthorityRow(
                owner_account_id=event.ownerAccountId,
                security_domain_id=cls.account.device_principal.security_domain_id,
                device_id=str(binding["deviceId"]),
                credential_id=cls.account.device_principal.credential_id,
                install_ack_id=str(binding["installAckId"]),
                static_authority_hash="d" * 64,
                effective_control_hash="e" * 64,
                mode=mode,
                active=True,
            ))

    @staticmethod
    def counts() -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
        with session_scope() as session:
            return (
                session.query(RoundBranchBindingRow).count(),
                session.query(LedgerPartitionRow).count(),
                session.query(RoundEventRow).count(),
                session.query(EventReceiptRow).count(),
            )

    def test_every_start_fault_rolls_back_and_same_event_retries(self) -> None:
        points = [
            "after_authority_verify", "after_partition_insert",
            "after_binding_insert", "after_event_insert", "after_receipt_insert",
        ]
        for index, point in enumerate(points, start=1):
            with self.subTest(point=point):
                temporary = self.open_database()
                try:
                    authority = SQLiteRoundStartBindingAuthority()
                    repo = LedgerRepository.create_schema_for_tests(
                        round_start_binding_authority=authority,
                        round_start_fault_hook=lambda observed, expected=point: (
                            (_ for _ in ()).throw(RuntimeError(expected))
                            if observed == expected else None
                        ),
                    )
                    round_id = f"11111111-1111-4111-8111-{index:012d}"
                    event = self.start_event(round_id=round_id)
                    self.seed_authority(event)
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, point):
                        repo.ingest_event(
                            round_id, event, input_index=0, account=self.account,
                        )
                    self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (0, 0, 0, 0))
                    with session_scope() as session:
                        self.assertEqual(
                            session.query(RoundStartSerializationLockRow).count(), 0,
                        )
                    retry = LedgerRepository(
                        round_start_binding_authority=authority,
                    ).ingest_event(
                        round_id, event, input_index=0, account=self.account,
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(retry.status, "accepted")
                    self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (1, 1, 1, 1))
                    with session_scope() as session:
                        self.assertEqual(
                            session.query(RoundStartSerializationLockRow).count(), 2,
                        )
                finally:
                    temporary.cleanup()

    def test_same_intent_is_idempotent_but_new_start_bytes_conflict(self) -> None:
        temporary = self.open_database()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        authority = SQLiteRoundStartBindingAuthority()
        repo = LedgerRepository.create_schema_for_tests(
            round_start_binding_authority=authority,
        )
        event = self.start_event(round_id="22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
        self.seed_authority(event)
        self.assertEqual(
            repo.ingest_event(event.roundId, event, input_index=0, account=self.account).status,
            "accepted",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            repo.ingest_event(event.roundId, event, input_index=0, account=self.account).status,
            "duplicate_hash_match",
        )
        changed = self.start_event(
            round_id=event.roundId,
            event_id="different-start-event",
            round_intent_id=str(event.roundIntentId),
            round_incarnation_id=event.streamSubject.roundIncarnationId,
        )
        conflict = repo.ingest_event(
            event.roundId, changed, input_index=0, account=self.account,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            (conflict.status, conflict.reason_code),
            ("rejected_permanent", "round_start_intent_conflict"),
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.counts()[:3], (1, 1, 1))

    def test_round_incarnation_cannot_be_reused_by_a_different_round(self) -> None:
        temporary = self.open_database()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        authority = SQLiteRoundStartBindingAuthority()
        repo = LedgerRepository.create_schema_for_tests(
            round_start_binding_authority=authority,
        )
        first = self.start_event(
            round_id="23232323-2323-4323-8323-232323232323",
            event_id="incarnation-owner-a",
            round_intent_id="incarnation-intent-a",
            round_incarnation_id="globally-owned-incarnation",
        )
        second = self.start_event(
            round_id="24242424-2424-4424-8424-242424242424",
            event_id="incarnation-owner-b",
            round_intent_id="incarnation-intent-b",
            round_incarnation_id="globally-owned-incarnation",
        )
        self.seed_authority(first)
        self.assertEqual(
            repo.ingest_event(first.roundId, first, input_index=0, account=self.account).status,
            "accepted",
        )
        rejected = repo.ingest_event(
            second.roundId, second, input_index=0, account=self.account,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            (rejected.status, rejected.reason_code),
            ("rejected_permanent", "round_binding_mismatch"),
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (1, 1, 1, 2))
        with session_scope() as session:
            self.assertEqual(session.query(EventDeadLetterRow).count(), 1)
            self.assertEqual(session.query(RoundStartSerializationLockRow).count(), 3)

    def test_accepted_exact_retry_bypasses_authority_that_became_unavailable(self) -> None:
        temporary = self.open_database()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        authority = SQLiteRoundStartBindingAuthority()
        repo = LedgerRepository.create_schema_for_tests(
            round_start_binding_authority=authority,
        )
        event = self.start_event(round_id="27272727-2727-4727-8727-272727272727")
        self.seed_authority(event)
        accepted = repo.ingest_event(
            event.roundId, event, input_index=0, account=self.account,
        )
        with session_scope(sqlite_immediate=True) as session:
            authority_row = session.scalar(select(TestRoundStartAuthorityRow))
            self.assertIsNotNone(authority_row)
            session.delete(authority_row)
        retry = repo.ingest_event(
            event.roundId, event, input_index=7, account=self.account,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            (accepted.status, retry.status, retry.input_index),
            ("accepted", "duplicate_hash_match", 7),
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (1, 1, 1, 1))

    def test_rejected_exact_retry_survives_authority_repair_without_ghost_start(self) -> None:
        temporary = self.open_database()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        authority = SQLiteRoundStartBindingAuthority()
        repo = LedgerRepository.create_schema_for_tests(
            round_start_binding_authority=authority,
        )
        event = self.start_event(round_id="28282828-2828-4828-8828-282828282828")
        self.seed_authority(event)
        with session_scope(sqlite_immediate=True) as session:
            authority_row = session.scalar(select(TestRoundStartAuthorityRow))
            self.assertIsNotNone(authority_row)
            authority_row.active = False
        with self.assertRaises(RoundStartAuthorityRejected):
            repo.ingest_event(
                event.roundId, event, input_index=0, account=self.account,
            )
        with session_scope(sqlite_immediate=True) as session:
            authority_row = session.scalar(select(TestRoundStartAuthorityRow))
            self.assertIsNotNone(authority_row)
            authority_row.active = True
        with self.assertRaises(RoundStartAuthorityRejected):
            repo.ingest_event(
                event.roundId, event, input_index=9, account=self.account,
            )
        self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (0, 0, 0, 1))
        with session_scope() as session:
            self.assertEqual(session.query(EventDeadLetterRow).count(), 1)
            self.assertEqual(session.query(RoundStartSerializationLockRow).count(), 0)

    def test_concurrent_same_start_has_one_binding_partition_event_and_receipt(self) -> None:
        temporary = self.open_database()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        authority = SQLiteRoundStartBindingAuthority()
        repo = LedgerRepository.create_schema_for_tests(
            round_start_binding_authority=authority,
        )
        event = self.start_event(round_id="33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333")
        self.seed_authority(event)
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
            receipts = list(executor.map(
                lambda _index: repo.ingest_event(
                    event.roundId, event, input_index=0, account=self.account,
                ),
                range(2),
            ))
        self.assertEqual(
            sorted(value.status for value in receipts),
            ["accepted", "duplicate_hash_match"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (1, 1, 1, 1))

    def test_single_unavailable_batch_retries_same_key_after_authority_recovers(self) -> None:
        temporary = self.open_database()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        authority = SQLiteRoundStartBindingAuthority()
        repo = LedgerRepository.create_schema_for_tests(
            round_start_binding_authority=authority,
        )
        app.dependency_overrides[get_ledger_repo] = lambda: repo
        app.dependency_overrides[current_account_context] = lambda: self.account
        self.addCleanup(app.dependency_overrides.clear)
        event = self.start_event(round_id="44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444")
        self.seed_authority(event, mode="unavailable")
        body = {"events": [event.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=False)]}
        headers = {
            "Idempotency-Key": "authority-unavailable-start-batch",
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": "ios-1",
        }
        client = TestClient(app)
        first = client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{event.roundId}/events",
            json=body,
            headers=headers,
        )
        self.assertEqual(first.status_code, 503)
        self.assertEqual(first.json(), {"code": "round_start_authority_unavailable"})
        self.assertEqual(first.headers["Retry-After"], "2")
        with session_scope() as session:
            row = session.scalar(select(BatchRequestRow))
            self.assertIsNotNone(row)
            self.assertFalse(row.complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (0, 0, 0, 0))

        with session_scope(sqlite_immediate=True) as session:
            authority_row = session.scalar(select(TestRoundStartAuthorityRow))
            self.assertIsNotNone(authority_row)
            authority_row.mode = "active"
        second = client.post(
            f"/api/v2/round-ledger/{event.roundId}/events",
            json=body,
            headers=headers,
        )
        self.assertEqual(second.json()["receipts"][0]["status"], "accepted")
        with session_scope() as session:
            row = session.scalar(select(BatchRequestRow))
            self.assertTrue(row.complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (1, 1, 1, 1))

    def test_authenticated_device_or_semantic_tamper_is_permanent(self) -> None:
        temporary = self.open_database()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        authority = SQLiteRoundStartBindingAuthority()
        repo = LedgerRepository.create_schema_for_tests(
            round_start_binding_authority=authority,
        )
        wrong_device = self.start_event(
            round_id="55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
            device_id="watch-other",
        )
        with self.assertRaises(RoundStartAuthorityRejected):
            repo.ingest_event(
                wrong_device.roundId, wrong_device, input_index=0, account=self.account,
            )

        tampered = self.start_event(
            round_id="66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
            semantic_binding_hash="f" * 64,
        )
        with self.assertRaises(RoundStartAuthorityRejected):
            repo.ingest_event(
                tampered.roundId, tampered, input_index=0, account=self.account,
            )

    @unittest.skipUnless(
        os.environ.get("AI_CADDIE_TEST_POSTGRES_URL"),
        "set AI_CADDIE_TEST_POSTGRES_URL to the isolated CI PostgreSQL database",
    )
    def test_postgresql_absent_row_race_is_serialized_without_integrity_error(self) -> None:
        previous = os.environ.get("AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL")
        os.environ["AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL"] = os.environ["AI_CADDIE_TEST_POSTGRES_URL"]
        reset_engine_for_tests()
        engine = get_engine()
        LedgerBase.metadata.drop_all(engine)
        LedgerBase.metadata.create_all(engine)
        try:
            authority = SQLiteRoundStartBindingAuthority()
            repo = LedgerRepository(round_start_binding_authority=authority)
            event = self.start_event(
                round_id="77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
                round_intent_id="postgres-intent",
                round_incarnation_id="postgres-incarnation",
            )
            self.seed_authority(event)
            barrier = Barrier(2)

            def ingest() -> StoredReceipt:
                barrier.wait(timeout=10)
                return repo.ingest_event(
                    event.roundId, event, input_index=0, account=self.account,
                )

            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
                receipts = [future.result(timeout=30) for future in (
                    executor.submit(ingest), executor.submit(ingest),
                )]
            self.assertEqual(
                sorted(receipt.status for receipt in receipts),
                ["accepted", "duplicate_hash_match"],
            )
            self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (1, 1, 1, 1))
            with session_scope() as session:
                self.assertEqual(session.query(RoundStartSerializationLockRow).count(), 2)

            first_conflict = self.start_event(
                round_id="78787878-7878-4878-8878-787878787878",
                event_id="postgres-conflict-a",
                round_intent_id="postgres-shared-intent",
                round_incarnation_id="postgres-incarnation-a",
            )
            second_conflict = self.start_event(
                round_id=first_conflict.roundId,
                event_id="postgres-conflict-b",
                round_intent_id="postgres-shared-intent",
                round_incarnation_id="postgres-incarnation-b",
            )
            conflict_barrier = Barrier(2)

            def ingest_conflict(value: RoundEventEnvelopeV2) -> StoredReceipt:
                conflict_barrier.wait(timeout=10)
                return repo.ingest_event(
                    value.roundId, value, input_index=0, account=self.account,
                )

            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
                conflicts = [future.result(timeout=30) for future in (
                    executor.submit(ingest_conflict, first_conflict),
                    executor.submit(ingest_conflict, second_conflict),
                )]
            self.assertEqual(
                sorted(receipt.status for receipt in conflicts),
                ["accepted", "rejected_permanent"],
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                {receipt.reason_code for receipt in conflicts if receipt.status == "rejected_permanent"},
                {"round_binding_mismatch"},
            )
            self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (2, 2, 2, 3))
            with session_scope() as session:
                self.assertEqual(session.query(EventDeadLetterRow).count(), 1)
                self.assertEqual(session.query(RoundStartSerializationLockRow).count(), 5)

            first_reuse = self.start_event(
                round_id="79797979-7979-4979-8979-797979797979",
                event_id="postgres-reuse-a",
                round_intent_id="postgres-reuse-intent-a",
                round_incarnation_id="postgres-shared-incarnation",
            )
            second_reuse = self.start_event(
                round_id="80808080-8080-4080-8080-808080808080",
                event_id="postgres-reuse-b",
                round_intent_id="postgres-reuse-intent-b",
                round_incarnation_id="postgres-shared-incarnation",
            )
            reuse_barrier = Barrier(2)

            def ingest_reuse(value: RoundEventEnvelopeV2) -> StoredReceipt:
                reuse_barrier.wait(timeout=10)
                return repo.ingest_event(
                    value.roundId, value, input_index=0, account=self.account,
                )

            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
                reused = [future.result(timeout=30) for future in (
                    executor.submit(ingest_reuse, first_reuse),
                    executor.submit(ingest_reuse, second_reuse),
                )]
            self.assertEqual(
                sorted(receipt.status for receipt in reused),
                ["accepted", "rejected_permanent"],
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                {receipt.reason_code for receipt in reused if receipt.status == "rejected_permanent"},
                {"round_binding_mismatch"},
            )
            self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (3, 3, 3, 5))

            invalid = self.start_event(
                round_id="81818181-8181-4181-8181-818181818181",
                event_id="postgres-concurrent-reject",
                round_intent_id="postgres-reject-intent",
                round_incarnation_id="postgres-reject-incarnation",
                device_id="wrong-device",
            )
            reject_barrier = Barrier(2)

            def reject_same() -> str:
                reject_barrier.wait(timeout=10)
                try:
                    repo.ingest_event(
                        invalid.roundId, invalid, input_index=6, account=self.account,
                    )
                except RoundStartAuthorityRejected:
                    return "round_start_binding_rejected"
                raise AssertionError("authority rejection did not escape after commit")

            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
                rejects = [future.result(timeout=30) for future in (
                    executor.submit(reject_same), executor.submit(reject_same),
                )]
            self.assertEqual(
                rejects,
                ["round_start_binding_rejected", "round_start_binding_rejected"],
            )
            self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (3, 3, 3, 6))
            with session_scope() as session:
                self.assertEqual(session.query(EventDeadLetterRow).count(), 3)
                self.assertEqual(session.query(RoundStartSerializationLockRow).count(), 8)

            raw_barrier = Barrier(2)

            def reject_raw() -> StoredReceipt:
                raw_barrier.wait(timeout=10)
                return repo.reject_raw_envelope(
                    owner_account_id="acct-1",
                    round_id="82828282-8282-4282-8282-828282828282",
                    input_index=4,
                    raw_event={"eventId": "broken", "payload": ["not-an-envelope"]},
                    reason_code="payload_schema_invalid",
                )

            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
                raw_rejects = [future.result(timeout=30) for future in (
                    executor.submit(reject_raw), executor.submit(reject_raw),
                )]
            self.assertEqual(
                [(receipt.status, receipt.reason_code, receipt.input_index) for receipt in raw_rejects],
                [
                    ("rejected_permanent", "payload_schema_invalid", 4),
                    ("rejected_permanent", "payload_schema_invalid", 4),
                ],
            )
            self.assertEqual(self.counts(), (3, 3, 3, 7))
            with session_scope() as session:
                self.assertEqual(session.query(EventDeadLetterRow).count(), 4)
                self.assertEqual(session.query(RoundStartSerializationLockRow).count(), 8)
        finally:
            LedgerBase.metadata.drop_all(engine)
            if previous is None:
                os.environ.pop("AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL", None)
            else:
                os.environ["AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL"] = previous
            reset_engine_for_tests()
```

该 SQLite authority fixture 只模拟 Plan 2 已 durable commit 的 install ACK/pin/control authority row；它仍通过 production protocol、verified principal、同一 SQLAlchemy session/lock 和真实 repository，不能用 caller Boolean。测试同时证明：authority material 暂时不可读时 HTTP 返回 503、batch 保持 incomplete；同一 key 在恢复后 accepted；事实性 missing/mismatch 则 durable reject 并统一返回 409；五个 fault point 后无 ghost binding/partition/event/receipt；terminal receipt 在 mutable authority 前获胜；并发 start 只有一个 canonical append。CI 必须提供隔离的 `AI_CADDIE_TEST_POSTGRES_URL`，不得把 PostgreSQL case 长期留在 skip 状态；该 case 专门证明 absent-row race 不依赖 SQLite `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`。
