```swift
            let valueKey = event.kind.rawValue == "hole_score_set" ? "strokes" : event.kind.rawValue == "putts_set" ? "putts" : "penalties"
            try exact(payload, ["hole", valueKey])
            let hole = try integer(payload["hole"], 1...18)
            if !isUnset(payload[valueKey]) {
                let range: ClosedRange<Int64> = valueKey == "strokes" ? 1...30 : 0...20
                _ = try integer(payload[valueKey], range)
            }
            try validateEntity(event, hole: hole)
        case "fairway_set":
            try exact(payload, ["hole", "fairway"])
            let hole = try integer(payload["hole"], 1...18)
            if !isUnset(payload["fairway"]) {
                guard Set(["hit", "miss_left", "miss_right", "not_applicable"]).contains(try string(payload["fairway"])) else {
                    throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("fairway")
                }
            }
            try validateEntity(event, hole: hole)
        case "flag_position_set":
            try exact(payload, ["hole", "latitude", "longitude", "provenance"])
            let hole = try integer(payload["hole"], 1...18)
            _ = try number(payload["latitude"], -90...90); _ = try number(payload["longitude"], -180...180)
            guard try string(payload["provenance"]) == "player_set" else { throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("provenance") }
            try validateEntity(event, hole: hole)
        case "shot_recorded":
            try exact(payload, ["shotId", "hole", "latitude", "longitude", "lie", "provenance"], optional: ["horizontalAccuracyM"])
            let shotId = try uuid(payload["shotId"]); _ = try integer(payload["hole"], 1...18)
            _ = try number(payload["latitude"], -90...90); _ = try number(payload["longitude"], -180...180)
            if let accuracy = payload["horizontalAccuracyM"], accuracy != .null { _ = try number(accuracy, 0...100_000) }
            guard lies.contains(try string(payload["lie"])), shotProvenance.contains(try string(payload["provenance"])) else {
                throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("shot fact")
            }
            try validateEntity(event, shotId: shotId)
        case "shot_target_set":
            try exact(payload, ["shotId", "targetRef", "latitude", "longitude", "provenance"])
            let shotId = try uuid(payload["shotId"]); _ = try string(payload["targetRef"])
            _ = try number(payload["latitude"], -90...90); _ = try number(payload["longitude"], -180...180)
            guard Set(["player_confirmed", "explicit_touch_target"]).contains(try string(payload["provenance"])) else {
                throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("target provenance")
            }
            try validateEntity(event, shotId: shotId)
        case "shot_target_retracted":
            try exact(payload, ["shotId", "reasonCode"])
            let shotId = try uuid(payload["shotId"])
            guard Set(["shot_target_orphaned", "player_cancelled_target"]).contains(try string(payload["reasonCode"])) else {
                throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("target retraction")
            }
            try validateEntity(event, shotId: shotId)
        case "shot_fact_corrected":
            try exact(payload, ["shotId", "patch"])
            let shotId = try uuid(payload["shotId"])
            guard case .object(let patch)? = payload["patch"], !patch.isEmpty,
                  Set(patch.keys).isSubset(of: ["latitude", "longitude", "horizontalAccuracyM", "lie", "provenance"]) else {
                throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("shot patch")
            }
            if let value = patch["latitude"] { _ = try number(value, -90...90) }
            if let value = patch["longitude"] { _ = try number(value, -180...180) }
            if let value = patch["horizontalAccuracyM"], value != .null { _ = try number(value, 0...100_000) }
            if let value = patch["lie"] { guard lies.contains(try string(value)) else { throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("lie") } }
            if let value = patch["provenance"] { guard shotProvenance.contains(try string(value)) else { throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("provenance") } }
            try validateEntity(event, shotId: shotId)
        case "shot_retracted":
            try exact(payload, ["shotId", "reasonCode"])
            let shotId = try uuid(payload["shotId"]); _ = try string(payload["reasonCode"])
            try validateEntity(event, shotId: shotId)
        case "actual_club_set":
            try exact(payload, ["shotId", "clubId"])
            let shotId = try uuid(payload["shotId"])
            if payload["clubId"] != .null, !isUnset(payload["clubId"]) { _ = try string(payload["clubId"]) }
            try validateEntity(event, shotId: shotId)
        case "resolution_opened":
            try exact(payload, ["resolutionId", "scopeId", "episodeKind", "previousHole", "candidateNextHole", "orderedHoleCursor", "suggestion", "evidence"])
            let resolutionId = try uuid(payload["resolutionId"])
            _ = try boundedString(payload["scopeId"], maximum: 256)
            let episodeKind = try string(payload["episodeKind"])
            guard Set(["next_hole", "final_hole"]).contains(episodeKind) else {
                throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("episodeKind")
            }
            _ = try integer(payload["previousHole"], 1...18)
            if episodeKind == "final_hole" {
                guard payload["candidateNextHole"] == .null else {
                    throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("final hole candidate")
                }
            } else {
                _ = try integer(payload["candidateNextHole"], 1...18)
            }
            _ = try integer(payload["orderedHoleCursor"], 0...35)
            try validateSuggestion(payload["suggestion"])
            try validateEvidence(payload["evidence"])
            try validateEntity(event, resolutionId: resolutionId)
        case "resolution_shot_staged":
            try exact(payload, ["resolutionId", "shotId", "captureOrdinal", "capturedAt", "latitude", "longitude", "horizontalAccuracyM", "lie", "provenance", "evidenceRefs"])
            let resolutionId = try uuid(payload["resolutionId"])
            let shotId = try uuid(payload["shotId"])
            _ = try integer(payload["captureOrdinal"], 1...64)
            _ = try timestamp(payload["capturedAt"])
            _ = try number(payload["latitude"], -90...90)
            _ = try number(payload["longitude"], -180...180)
            if payload["horizontalAccuracyM"] != .null { _ = try number(payload["horizontalAccuracyM"], 0...1_000) }
            guard Set(["tee", "fairway", "rough", "bunker", "fringe", "other"]).contains(try string(payload["lie"])),
                  Set(["manual", "autoshot_observed"]).contains(try string(payload["provenance"])) else {
                throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("staged shot")
            }
            _ = try boundedUniqueStrings(payload["evidenceRefs"], maximum: 32)
            try validateEntity(event, shotId: shotId, resolutionId: resolutionId)
        case "resolution_closed":
            try exact(payload, ["resolutionId", "resolutionCommitId", "decisionHash", "disposition"])
            let resolutionId = try uuid(payload["resolutionId"])
            let resolutionCommitId = try hash(payload["resolutionCommitId"])
            _ = try hash(payload["decisionHash"])
            guard Set(["accepted_default", "manually_confirmed", "cancelled", "superseded"]).contains(try string(payload["disposition"])) else {
                throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("disposition")
            }
            if let transactionRef = event.transactionRef,
               transactionRef.resolutionCommitId != resolutionCommitId {
                throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("resolution commit id mismatch")
            }
            try validateEntity(event, resolutionId: resolutionId)
        case "round_merge_resolution":
            try exact(payload, ["resolutionId", "revision", "canonicalRoundId", "membershipMode", "sources", "policyVersion"])
            _ = try string(payload["resolutionId"]); _ = try integer(payload["revision"], 1...Int64.max)
            guard try string(payload["canonicalRoundId"]) == event.roundId,
                  try string(payload["membershipMode"]) == "live_until_superseded",
                  case .array(let sources)? = payload["sources"], !sources.isEmpty,
                  case .mergeControl(let mergeControlId) = event.streamSubject,
                  event.entityRef == "merge:\(mergeControlId)" else {
                throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("merge resolution")
            }
            for source in sources {
                guard case .object(let row) = source else { throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("merge source") }
                try exact(row, ["roundId", "roundIncarnationId", "checkpointHash", "sourceOrdinal"])
                _ = try string(row["roundId"]); _ = try string(row["roundIncarnationId"])
                guard (try string(row["checkpointHash"])).range(of: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$", options: .regularExpression) != nil else {
                    throw RoundPayloadValidationError.invalid("merge checkpoint")
                }
                _ = try integer(row["sourceOrdinal"], 0...Int64.max)
            }
            _ = try string(payload["policyVersion"])
        default:
            try validateEntity(event)
        }
    }
}
```

`ShotCaptureSession` 不是第二份 sidecar store。`DomainLedgerStateV2` 新增 `shotCaptureStates: [String: DurableShotCaptureState]`，key 固定为 `roundId + "|" + roundIncarnationId`；target append、shot append/outbox、完成旧 slot 和预留下一 slot 都复用 `DomainLedgerStore.transaction` 的同一个 atomic replace：

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainLedgerStore.swift
private func shotCaptureKey(roundId: String, roundIncarnationId: String) -> String {
    "\(roundId)|\(roundIncarnationId)"
}

public extension DomainLedgerStore {
    func ensureShotCaptureState(roundId: String, roundIncarnationId: String) throws {
        try transaction { state in
            let key = shotCaptureKey(roundId: roundId, roundIncarnationId: roundIncarnationId)
            if let existing = state.shotCaptureStates[key] {
                guard existing.roundId == roundId,
                      existing.roundIncarnationId == roundIncarnationId else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.roundContextMismatch
                }
                return
            }
            state.shotCaptureStates[key] = DurableShotCaptureState(
                roundId: roundId,
                roundIncarnationId: roundIncarnationId,
                active: ShotCaptureSlot(
                    shotId: UUID().uuidString.lowercased(),
                    phase: .reserved,
                    eventIdentity: nil,
                    eventHash: nil
                ),
                lastCompleted: nil
            )
        }
    }

    func shotCaptureState(roundId: String, roundIncarnationId: String) throws -> DurableShotCaptureState {
        try locked {
            let state = try loadV2()
            guard let capture = state.shotCaptureStates[
                shotCaptureKey(roundId: roundId, roundIncarnationId: roundIncarnationId)
            ], capture.roundId == roundId, capture.roundIncarnationId == roundIncarnationId else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.roundContextMismatch
            }
            return capture
        }
    }

    func appendTargetAtomically(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        roundId: String,
        roundIncarnationId: String
    ) throws {
        try transaction { state in
            let key = shotCaptureKey(roundId: roundId, roundIncarnationId: roundIncarnationId)
            guard let capture = state.shotCaptureStates[key],
                  capture.roundId == event.roundId,
                  capture.roundId == roundId,
                  capture.roundIncarnationId == roundIncarnationId,
                  event.streamSubject == .roundIncarnation(roundIncarnationId),
                  [.shotTargetSet, .shotTargetRetracted].contains(event.kind),
                  event.payload["shotId"] == .string(capture.active.shotId) else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.roundContextMismatch
            }
            try appendValidated(event, to: &state)
        }
    }

    func appendShotAndReserveNextAtomically(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        roundId: String,
        roundIncarnationId: String
    ) throws {
        let identity = try event.eventIdentity()
        let eventHash = try event.eventHash()
        try transaction { state in
            let key = shotCaptureKey(roundId: roundId, roundIncarnationId: roundIncarnationId)
            guard var capture = state.shotCaptureStates[key],
                  capture.roundId == event.roundId,
                  capture.roundId == roundId,
                  capture.roundIncarnationId == roundIncarnationId,
                  event.streamSubject == .roundIncarnation(roundIncarnationId),
                  event.kind == .shotRecorded else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.roundContextMismatch
            }

            if capture.lastCompleted?.eventIdentity == identity {
                guard capture.lastCompleted?.eventHash == eventHash,
                      state.events.contains(where: { (try? $0.eventIdentity()) == identity }) else {
                    throw DomainLedgerError.identityEnvelopeMismatch
                }
                return
            }
            guard event.payload["shotId"] == .string(capture.active.shotId),
                  capture.active.phase == .reserved else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.shotIdentityConflict
            }

            try appendValidated(event, to: &state)
            capture.lastCompleted = ShotCaptureSlot(
                shotId: capture.active.shotId,
                phase: .completed,
                eventIdentity: identity,
                eventHash: eventHash
            )
            capture.active = ShotCaptureSlot(
                shotId: UUID().uuidString.lowercased(),
                phase: .reserved,
                eventIdentity: nil,
                eventHash: nil
            )
            state.shotCaptureStates[key] = capture
        }
    }

    func appendValidated(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        to state: inout DomainLedgerStateV2,
        projectionAuthority: ProjectionAuthority = .localProvisional
    ) throws {
        guard projectionAuthority != .canonicalReplay else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.roundContextMismatch
        }
        try RoundPayloadValidator.validate(event)
        let identity = try event.eventIdentity()
        let eventHash = try event.eventHash()
        if let existing = state.events.first(where: { (try? $0.eventIdentity()) == identity }) {
            guard try existing.eventHash() == eventHash else {
                throw DomainLedgerError.identityEnvelopeMismatch
            }
            return
        }
        state.events.append(event)
        state.localProjectionInputs.append(DomainProjectionInput(
            event: event,
            projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                authority: projectionAuthority,
                ledgerPartitionId: nil,
                ledgerPosition: nil,
                sourceOrdinal: event.clientSequence
            )
        ))
        state.outbox.append(OutboxRecord(
            event: event,
            eventIdentity: identity,
            eventHash: eventHash,
            receipt: nil,
            deadLetterReason: nil
        ))
    }
}
```

普通 `DomainLedgerStore.append()` 也只是在同一 transaction 调用 `appendValidated()`；因此本地 producer、Watch relay、migration 与 server replay 都无法绕过 generated kind-specific payload validator。fault injection tests 分别在 transaction replace 前和 replace 后强杀：前者同时看不到 shot event 与 rotation，后者同时看到 shot event、outbox、completed slot 和全新 reserved UUID；不存在半完成状态。

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/ShotCapture/PlayerLiveFactProducer.swift
public enum PlayerLiveFactProducerError: Error, Equatable {
    case invalidShotTargetProvenance(String)
    case invalidCoordinates
    case invalidHole
    case emptyTargetRef
    case missingTargetRevision
    case roundContextMismatch
}

public enum ShotTargetProvenance: String, Codable, Equatable {
    case playerConfirmed = "player_confirmed"
    case explicitTouchTarget = "explicit_touch_target"

    public init(validating rawValue: String) throws {
        guard let value = ShotTargetProvenance(rawValue: rawValue) else {
            throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.invalidShotTargetProvenance(rawValue)
        }
        self = value
    }
}

public enum ShotTargetRetractionReason: String, Codable, Equatable {
    case shotTargetOrphaned = "shot_target_orphaned"
    case playerCancelledTarget = "player_cancelled_target"
}

public struct PlayerLiveFactProducer {
    public init() {}

    public func setShotTarget(
        session: ShotCaptureSession,
        targetRef: String,
        latitude: Double,
        longitude: Double,
        provenance: ShotTargetProvenance,
        builder: DomainEventBuilder,
        projection: DomainRoundProjection,
        occurredAt: String
    ) throws -> DomainRoundEvent {
        guard session.roundId == builder.context.roundId,
              session.roundIncarnationId == builder.context.roundIncarnationId else {
            throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.roundContextMismatch
        }
        guard !targetRef.isEmpty else { throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.emptyTargetRef }
        guard (-90...90).contains(latitude), (-180...180).contains(longitude) else {
            throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.invalidCoordinates
        }
        let entity = "round:\(builder.context.roundId):shot:\(session.shotId):target"
        return try builder.make(
            kind: .shotTargetSet,
            entityRef: entity,
            payload: [
                "shotId": .string(session.shotId), "targetRef": .string(targetRef),
                "latitude": .number(latitude), "longitude": .number(longitude),
                "provenance": .string(provenance.rawValue),
            ],
            baseRevision: projection.revision(for: entity) ?? .absent(scopeId: entity),
            occurredAt: occurredAt
        )
    }

    public func retractShotTarget(
        session: ShotCaptureSession,
        reason: ShotTargetRetractionReason,
        builder: DomainEventBuilder,
        projection: DomainRoundProjection,
        occurredAt: String
    ) throws -> DomainRoundEvent {
        guard session.roundId == builder.context.roundId,
              session.roundIncarnationId == builder.context.roundIncarnationId else {
            throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.roundContextMismatch
        }
        let entity = "round:\(builder.context.roundId):shot:\(session.shotId):target"
        guard let base = projection.revision(for: entity) else {
            throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.missingTargetRevision
        }
        return try builder.make(
            kind: .shotTargetRetracted,
            entityRef: entity,
            payload: [
                "shotId": .string(session.shotId),
                "reasonCode": .string(reason.rawValue),
            ],
            baseRevision: base,
            occurredAt: occurredAt
        )
    }

    public func setFlagPosition(
        hole: Int,
        latitude: Double,
        longitude: Double,
        builder: DomainEventBuilder,
        projection: DomainRoundProjection,
        occurredAt: String
    ) throws -> DomainRoundEvent {
        guard (1...18).contains(hole) else { throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.invalidHole }
        guard (-90...90).contains(latitude), (-180...180).contains(longitude) else {
            throw PlayerLiveFactProducerError.invalidCoordinates
        }
        let entity = "round:\(builder.context.roundId):hole:\(hole):flagPosition"
        return try builder.make(
            kind: .flagPositionSet,
            entityRef: entity,
            payload: [
                "hole": .integer(Int64(hole)), "latitude": .number(latitude),
                "longitude": .number(longitude), "provenance": .string("player_set"),
            ],
            baseRevision: projection.revision(for: entity) ?? .absent(scopeId: entity),
            occurredAt: occurredAt
        )
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomainTests/PlayerLiveFactProducerTests.swift
import XCTest
@testable import AICaddieDomain

final class PlayerLiveFactProducerTests: XCTestCase {
    private let roundId = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

    func testPayloadValidatorCoversEveryRegisteredKind() {
        XCTAssertEqual(RoundPayloadValidator.handledKinds, RoundEventKind.knownValues)
    }

    func testInvalidOrInferredTargetProvenanceThrows() {
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try ShotTargetProvenance(validating: "guidance_inferred")) { error in
            XCTAssertEqual(
                error as? PlayerLiveFactProducerError,
                .invalidShotTargetProvenance("guidance_inferred")
            )
        }
    }

    func testTouchRestartAndShotCommitReuseThenRotateDurableShotId() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        addTeardownBlock { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let originURL = root.appendingPathComponent("origin.json")
        let builder = try DomainEventBuilder.fixture(roundId: roundId, originURL: originURL)
        let producer = PlayerLiveFactProducer()
        var ledger: DomainLedgerStore? = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: root.appendingPathComponent("ledger"))
        var projection = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
            [],
            replication: DomainReplicationContext(pendingCount: 0, syncing: false, deadLetterCount: 0)
        )
        var session: ShotCaptureSession? = try ShotCaptureSession(
            ledger: try XCTUnwrap(ledger),
            context: builder.context
        )
        let reservedShotId = try XCTUnwrap(session?.shotId)
        let target = try producer.setShotTarget(
            session: try XCTUnwrap(session), targetRef: "touch:green-front",
            latitude: 22.3001, longitude: 114.2001, provenance: .explicitTouchTarget,
            builder: builder, projection: projection, occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        )
        try XCTUnwrap(session).appendTarget(target)
        projection = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
            [DomainProjectionInput(
                event: target,
                projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                    authority: .localProvisional,
                    ledgerPartitionId: nil,
                    ledgerPosition: nil,
                    sourceOrdinal: 1
                )
            )],
            replication: DomainReplicationContext(pendingCount: 1, syncing: false, deadLetterCount: 0)
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(projection.shotTargets[reservedShotId]?.orphaned, true)

        session = nil
        ledger = nil
        let restartedLedger = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: root.appendingPathComponent("ledger"))
        let restarted = try ShotCaptureSession(ledger: restartedLedger, context: builder.context)
        XCTAssertEqual(restarted.shotId, reservedShotId)
        let shot = try ManualShotProducer().record(
            ManualShotDraft(
                hole: 1, latitude: 22.2999, longitude: 114.1999,
                horizontalAccuracyM: 4, lie: "fairway"
            ),
            session: restarted,
            builder: builder,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:01.000Z"
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(shot.payload["shotId"], .string(reservedShotId))
        try restarted.appendShotAndReserveNext(shot)
        XCTAssertNotEqual(restarted.shotId, reservedShotId)
        projection = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
            try restartedLedger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId),
            replication: DomainReplicationContext(pendingCount: 2, syncing: false, deadLetterCount: 0)
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(projection.shotTargets[reservedShotId]?.orphaned, false)
        try restarted.appendShotAndReserveNext(shot)
        XCTAssertEqual(try restartedLedger.allEvents().filter { $0.kind == .shotRecorded }, [shot])
    }

    func testTargetRetractionStaysOnCurrentReservedShot() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        let builder = try DomainEventBuilder.fixture(roundId: roundId, originURL: root.appendingPathComponent("origin.json"))
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: root.appendingPathComponent("ledger"))
        let session = try ShotCaptureSession(ledger: ledger, context: builder.context)
        let producer = PlayerLiveFactProducer()
        var projection = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
            [], replication: DomainReplicationContext(pendingCount: 0, syncing: false, deadLetterCount: 0)
        )
        let target = try producer.setShotTarget(
            session: session, targetRef: "touch:green-front", latitude: 22.3001, longitude: 114.2001,
            provenance: .explicitTouchTarget, builder: builder, projection: projection,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        )
        try session.appendTarget(target)
        projection = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
            try ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId),
            replication: DomainReplicationContext(pendingCount: 1, syncing: false, deadLetterCount: 0)
        )
        let retracted = try producer.retractShotTarget(
            session: session, reason: .playerCancelledTarget,
            builder: builder, projection: projection,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:02.000Z"
        )
        try session.appendTarget(retracted)
        XCTAssertEqual(retracted.kind, .shotTargetRetracted)
        XCTAssertEqual(retracted.payload["reasonCode"], .string("player_cancelled_target"))
        XCTAssertNotNil(retracted.baseEntityRevision)
    }

    func testConsecutiveShotsUseDifferentIdsAndWrongRoundFailsClosed() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        let builder = try DomainEventBuilder.fixture(roundId: roundId, originURL: root.appendingPathComponent("origin.json"))
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: root.appendingPathComponent("ledger"))
        let session = try ShotCaptureSession(ledger: ledger, context: builder.context)
        let firstId = session.shotId
        let first = try ManualShotProducer().record(
            ManualShotDraft(hole: 1, latitude: 22.3, longitude: 114.2, horizontalAccuracyM: 4, lie: "tee"),
            session: session, builder: builder, occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        )
        try session.appendShotAndReserveNext(first)
        let secondId = session.shotId
        let second = try ManualShotProducer().record(
            ManualShotDraft(hole: 1, latitude: 22.301, longitude: 114.201, horizontalAccuracyM: 4, lie: "fairway"),
            session: session, builder: builder, occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:01:00.000Z"
        )
        try session.appendShotAndReserveNext(second)
        XCTAssertNotEqual(firstId, secondId)
        let shotIds = try ledger.allEvents().compactMap { event -> String? in
            if case .string(let value)? = event.payload["shotId"] { return value }
            return nil
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(Set(shotIds).count, 2)

        let other = try DomainEventBuilder.fixture(
            roundId: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
            originURL: root.appendingPathComponent("other-origin.json")
        )
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try ManualShotProducer().record(
            ManualShotDraft(hole: 1, latitude: 22.3, longitude: 114.2, horizontalAccuracyM: 4, lie: "tee"),
            session: session, builder: other, occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:02:00.000Z"
        )) { error in
            XCTAssertEqual(error as? PlayerLiveFactProducerError, .roundContextMismatch)
        }

        let crossContext = RoundEventContext(
            ownerAccountId: builder.context.ownerAccountId,
            subjectPlayerId: builder.context.subjectPlayerId,
            actorId: builder.context.actorId,
            roundId: roundId,
            roundIntentId: builder.context.roundIntentId,
            roundIncarnationId: "inc-cross",
            snapshotId: builder.context.snapshotId,
            semanticBindingHash: builder.context.semanticBindingHash,
            deviceRoundInstallBinding: builder.context.deviceRoundInstallBinding
        )
        let crossBuilder = DomainEventBuilder(
            deviceId: "ios-cross",
            origin: try OriginSequenceStore(url: root.appendingPathComponent("cross-origin.json")),
            context: crossContext
        )
        let currentId = session.shotId
        let crafted = try crossBuilder.make(
            kind: .shotRecorded,
            entityRef: "round:\(roundId):shot:\(currentId)",
            payload: [
                "shotId": .string(currentId), "hole": .integer(1),
                "latitude": .number(22.3), "longitude": .number(114.2),
                "horizontalAccuracyM": .number(4), "lie": .string("tee"),
                "provenance": .string("manual"),
            ],
            baseRevision: nil,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:03:00.000Z"
        )
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try session.appendShotAndReserveNext(crafted))
    }

    func testShotAppendAndReservationRotationAreOneAtomicReplace() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        let builder = try DomainEventBuilder.fixture(roundId: roundId, originURL: root.appendingPathComponent("origin.json"))

        var failBefore = false
        let beforeURL = root.appendingPathComponent("before")
        let beforeLedger = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: beforeURL, faultHook: { point in
            if failBefore && point == .beforeAtomicReplace { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) }
        })
        let beforeSession = try ShotCaptureSession(ledger: beforeLedger, context: builder.context)
        let beforeId = beforeSession.shotId
        let beforeEvent = try ManualShotProducer().record(
            ManualShotDraft(hole: 1, latitude: 22.3, longitude: 114.2, horizontalAccuracyM: 4, lie: "tee"),
            session: beforeSession, builder: builder, occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        )
        failBefore = true
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try beforeSession.appendShotAndReserveNext(beforeEvent))
        let beforeRestartLedger = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: beforeURL)
        let beforeRestart = try ShotCaptureSession(ledger: beforeRestartLedger, context: builder.context)
        XCTAssertEqual(beforeRestart.shotId, beforeId)
        XCTAssertEqual(try beforeRestartLedger.allEvents(), [])

        var failAfter = false
        let afterURL = root.appendingPathComponent("after")
        let afterLedger = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: afterURL, faultHook: { point in
            if failAfter && point == .afterAtomicReplace { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) }
        })
        let afterSession = try ShotCaptureSession(ledger: afterLedger, context: builder.context)
        let afterId = afterSession.shotId
        let afterEvent = try ManualShotProducer().record(
            ManualShotDraft(hole: 1, latitude: 22.3, longitude: 114.2, horizontalAccuracyM: 4, lie: "tee"),
            session: afterSession, builder: builder, occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:01:00.000Z"
        )
        failAfter = true
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try afterSession.appendShotAndReserveNext(afterEvent))
        let afterRestartLedger = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: afterURL)
        let afterRestart = try ShotCaptureSession(ledger: afterRestartLedger, context: builder.context)
        XCTAssertNotEqual(afterRestart.shotId, afterId)
        XCTAssertEqual(try afterRestartLedger.allEvents().filter { $0.kind == .shotRecorded }, [afterEvent])
        let nextId = afterRestart.shotId
        try afterRestart.appendShotAndReserveNext(afterEvent)
        XCTAssertEqual(afterRestart.shotId, nextId)
        XCTAssertEqual(try afterRestartLedger.allEvents().filter { $0.kind == .shotRecorded }.count, 1)
    }

    func testFlagPositionAlwaysUsesPlayerSetProvenance() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        let builder = try DomainEventBuilder.fixture(roundId: roundId, originURL: root.appendingPathComponent("origin.json"))
        let projection = try DomainRoundReducer().reduce(
            [],
            replication: DomainReplicationContext(pendingCount: 0, syncing: false, deadLetterCount: 0)
        )
        let event = try PlayerLiveFactProducer().setFlagPosition(
            hole: 1, latitude: 22.3, longitude: 114.2,
            builder: builder, projection: projection,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(event.payload["provenance"], .string("player_set"))
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try PlayerLiveFactProducer().setFlagPosition(
            hole: 19, latitude: 22.3, longitude: 114.2,
            builder: builder, projection: projection,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        ))
    }

    func testLedgerRejectsBypassedInvalidPayloadAndEntityBinding() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        let builder = try DomainEventBuilder.fixture(roundId: roundId, originURL: root.appendingPathComponent("origin.json"))
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: root.appendingPathComponent("ledger"))
        let entity = "round:\(roundId):hole:1:flagPosition"
        let invalid = try builder.make(
            kind: .flagPositionSet,
            entityRef: entity,
            payload: [
                "hole": .integer(19), "latitude": .number(22.3),
                "longitude": .number(114.2), "provenance": .string("map_inferred"),
            ],
            baseRevision: .absent(scopeId: entity),
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        )
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try ledger.append(invalid))
        XCTAssertEqual(try ledger.allEvents(), [])
    }
}
```

Guidance candidate、green geometry、GPS/map default 与 next-shot state 都不持有 `PlayerLiveFactProducer`；dependency graph test 对这些 target 搜索 constructor reference，必须为 0。Plan 4 只能注入 typed `.playerConfirmed`/`.explicitTouchTarget`，不能传任意字符串。

`ManualShotProducerTests` 断言 payload 只有 canonical shot facts，不含 `guidanceId/recommendedClubRef/actualClubRef`；同一 event 经 Watch direct 和 phone relay 保持同 identity/hash。

`CanonicalJSON.swift` 把 `JSONValue` 递归转换为 Foundation object，先验证 NFC/negative-zero/safe integer，再调用 vendored `_serialize`；`TypedID.make` 使用 `CryptoKit.SHA256` 计算 `domainTag + NUL + canonicalBytes`。本 step 后面的 `DomainRoundReducer.swift` 是 normative 完整实现；禁止用“照 Python 移植”替代源码。

同时把 Phase 0 receipt 升级为 wire-complete 结构：

```swift
public struct EventReceipt: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let eventId: String?
    public let eventIdentity: String?
    public let eventHash: String?
    public let inputIndex: Int
    public let status: ReceiptStatus
    public let ledgerPartitionId: String?
    public let ledgerEpoch: Int?
    public let streamId: String?
    public let ledgerPosition: CanonicalLedgerPosition?
    public let currentEntityRevision: EntityRevisionToken?
    public let reasonCode: ReasonCode?

    public init(
        eventId: String?,
        eventIdentity: String?,
        eventHash: String?,
        inputIndex: Int,
        status: ReceiptStatus,
        ledgerPartitionId: String?,
        ledgerEpoch: Int?,
        streamId: String?,
        ledgerPosition: CanonicalLedgerPosition?,
        currentEntityRevision: EntityRevisionToken?,
        reasonCode: ReasonCode?
    ) {
        self.eventId = eventId
        self.eventIdentity = eventIdentity
        self.eventHash = eventHash
        self.inputIndex = inputIndex
        self.status = status
        self.ledgerPartitionId = ledgerPartitionId
        self.ledgerEpoch = ledgerEpoch
        self.streamId = streamId
        self.ledgerPosition = ledgerPosition
        self.currentEntityRevision = currentEntityRevision
        self.reasonCode = reasonCode
    }
}

public struct EventWriteResponseV2: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let schema: String
    public let requestHash: String
    public let requestBodySha256: String
    public let eventCount: Int
    public let receipts: [EventReceipt]
}

public struct ValidatedEventWriteResponse: Sendable {
    let response: EventWriteResponseV2
    let request: PreparedEventWriteRequest

    init(response: EventWriteResponseV2, request: PreparedEventWriteRequest) {
        self.response = response
        self.request = request
    }
}

public struct OutboxRecord: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let event: DomainRoundEvent
    public let eventIdentity: String
    public let eventHash: String
    public var receipt: EventReceipt?
    public var deadLetterReason: String?
}

public struct EventWriteRequestSlot: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let event: DomainRoundEvent
    public let eventIdentity: String
    public let eventHash: String
}

public struct PreparedEventWriteRequest: Equatable, Sendable {
    public let roundId: String
    public let body: Data
    public let requestHash: String
    public let requestBodySha256: String
    public let slots: [EventWriteRequestSlot]

    init(
        roundId: String,
        body: Data,
        requestHash: String,
        requestBodySha256: String,
        slots: [EventWriteRequestSlot]
    ) {
        self.roundId = roundId
        self.body = body
        self.requestHash = requestHash
        self.requestBodySha256 = requestBodySha256
        self.slots = slots
    }
}
```

`DomainLedgerStore.prepareEventWriteRequest(roundId:limit:)` 是 `PreparedEventWriteRequest` 的唯一 initializer owner：在 ledger lock 内按 outbox durable 顺序 defensive-copy，逐项构造并选择同时满足 generated `maxEventsPerBatch=64` 与 exact canonical body `maxHttpBodyBytes=1_048_576` 的最大前缀，把 `{"events":[...]}` 编成唯一 canonical body，`requestHash = TypedID("RoundEventBatch/v1", {roundId,events})`，`requestBodySha256 = SHA256(exact body)`；若首项自身仍超限，说明 append-time 65,536-byte event guard或storage已损坏，builder fail closed并由 `flushOutbox` 记录 visible `local_transport_invariant_violation`，原 outbox保持不变等待 repair；caller limit越界立即拒绝。重试复用同一个 value 的 exact body/hash/slot roster，不能重新读取已变化的 outbox或重编码。tests覆盖恰好64、65分页、63/64项跨过byte limit、单项损坏时 anomaly+outbox不变，以及重试时outbox改变但prepared bytes/roster不变。`EventWriteResponseValidator`先对raw response bytes运行generated exact schema/duplicate-key validator，再验证`schema/requestHash/requestBodySha256/eventCount`、receipt索引恰好按顺序覆盖`0..<eventCount`、每槽`eventId`与immutable request snapshot一致。identity非null时必须与该槽event identity/hash精确相等；identity null只允许`rejected_permanent`，`identity_envelope_mismatch`可保留incoming event hash，其他raw reject的hash必须null。success receipt必须携带完整canonical coordinate；non-appended receipt四个coordinate fields都必须null。验证完成才产生不可公开构造的`ValidatedEventWriteResponse`。

Task 5 的 `DomainLedgerState.receipts` 改为 string storage key：identity 非 null 用 `eventIdentity`，raw reject 用 `requestBodySha256 + "#" + inputIndex`；`append()` 先计算 identity/hash，以完整 identity 去重，同 identity/different hash 抛 mismatch。不同 origin 即使碰巧复用同一个 `eventId` 仍是两条合法 event。删除 network-facing 单条 `apply(receipt:)`；`apply(validatedResponse:)` 在一个 local transaction 内按 immutable request slot 处理整包，null identity 永远只作用于该 input index，不能按 identity 删除任意 outbox。任何顶层 hash/count、额外/缺失/重排 receipt 或槽 identity/hash mismatch 都在 state mutation 前记录 visible transport anomaly，原 outbox 全部 retryable。`accepted/duplicate_hash_match/accepted_opaque` 才持久化 receipt、写 `acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay` 并删除 transport item；`deferred` 留 queue；`rejected_permanent` 原子移入 visible dead letter。

```swift
public extension DomainLedgerStore {
    func append(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        try transaction { state in
            try appendValidated(event, to: &state)
        }
    }

    func appendIfIdentityHashMatches(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws { try append(event) }
    func importLegacyPending(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws { try append(event) }

    private func makePreparedRequest(
        roundId: String,
        rows: [OutboxRecord]
    ) throws -> PreparedEventWriteRequest {
        let slots = rows.map {
            EventWriteRequestSlot(
                event: $0.event,
                eventIdentity: $0.eventIdentity,
                eventHash: $0.eventHash
            )
        }
        let eventsValue = try slots.map {
            try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(JSONValue.self, from: JSONEncoder().encode($0.event))
        }
        let body = try CanonicalJSON.data(JSONValue.object(["events": .array(eventsValue)]))
        let requestHash = try TypedID.make(
            domain: "RoundEventBatch/v1",
            value: .object([
                "roundId": .string(roundId),
                "events": .array(eventsValue),
            ])
        )
        let bodySha = SHA256.hash(data: body).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
        return PreparedEventWriteRequest(
            roundId: roundId,
            body: body,
            requestHash: requestHash,
            requestBodySha256: bodySha,
            slots: slots
        )
    }

    func prepareEventWriteRequest(
        roundId: String,
        limit: Int = RoundTransportLimits.maxEventsPerBatch
    ) throws -> PreparedEventWriteRequest? {
        guard (1...RoundTransportLimits.maxEventsPerBatch).contains(limit) else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.transportLimitExceeded
        }
        return try locked {
            let candidates = try loadV2().outbox.filter {
                $0.event.roundId == roundId && $0.deadLetterReason == nil
            }
            var selected: [OutboxRecord] = []
            for row in candidates.prefix(limit) {
                let candidate = selected + [row]
                let request = try makePreparedRequest(roundId: roundId, rows: candidate)
                if request.body.count > RoundTransportLimits.maxHttpBodyBytes {
                    if selected.isEmpty { throw DomainLedgerError.transportLimitExceeded }
                    break
                }
                selected = candidate
            }
            guard !selected.isEmpty else { return nil }
            return try makePreparedRequest(roundId: roundId, rows: selected)
        }
    }

    func prepareRoundStartedEventWriteRequest(
        roundId: String
    ) throws -> PreparedEventWriteRequest? {
        try locked {
            let state = try loadV2()
            guard state.activeInboundPartitionsByRound[roundId, default: []].isEmpty else {
                return nil
            }
            let rows = state.outbox.filter {
                $0.event.roundId == roundId
                    && $0.event.kind.rawValue == "round_started"
                    && $0.deadLetterReason == nil
            }
            guard !rows.isEmpty else { return nil }
            guard rows.count == 1 else { throw DomainLedgerError.roundStartConflict }
            return try makePreparedRequest(roundId: roundId, rows: rows)
        }
    }

    func syncProgressFingerprint(roundId: String) throws -> String {
        try locked {
            let state = try loadV2()
            let cursors = state.inboundCursors.values
                .filter { $0.syncRoundId == roundId }
                .sorted { $0.ledgerPartitionId < $1.ledgerPartitionId }
                .map { cursor in
                    JSONValue.object([
                        "partition": .string(cursor.ledgerPartitionId),
                        "generation": .integer(Int64(cursor.mergeControlGeneration)),
                        "persisted": .string(cursor.persistedThrough.rawValue),
                        "acked": .string(cursor.ackedThrough.rawValue),
                    ])
                }
            return try TypedID.make(
                domain: "RoundSyncProgress/v1",
                value: .object([
                    "roundId": .string(roundId),
                    "cursors": .array(cursors),
                    "outbox": .array(state.outbox.filter { $0.event.roundId == roundId }
                        .map(\.eventIdentity).sorted().map(JSONValue.string)),
                    "awaiting": .array(state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay.keys.sorted()
                        .map(JSONValue.string)),
                    "deadLetters": .array(state.deadLetters.filter { $0.event.roundId == roundId }
                        .map(\.eventIdentity).sorted().map(JSONValue.string)),
                ])
            )
        }
    }

    func apply(validatedResponse value: ValidatedEventWriteResponse) throws {
        try transaction { state in
            for (slot, receipt) in zip(
                value.request.slots, value.response.receipts
            ) {
                let storageKey = receipt.eventIdentity
                    ?? "\(value.request.requestBodySha256)#\(receipt.inputIndex)"
                guard let index = state.outbox.firstIndex(where: {
                    $0.eventIdentity == slot.eventIdentity
                        && $0.eventHash == slot.eventHash
                }) else {
                    if state.receipts[storageKey] != nil { continue }
                    throw DomainLedgerError.transportReceiptSlotMismatch
                }
                switch receipt.status {
                case .accepted, .duplicateHashMatch, .acceptedOpaque:
                    state.receipts[storageKey] = receipt
                    state.acceptedAwaitingCanonicalReplay[slot.eventIdentity] = receipt
                    state.localProjectionInputs = try state.localProjectionInputs.map { input in
                        guard try input.event.eventIdentity() == slot.eventIdentity else { return input }
                        return DomainProjectionInput(
                            event: input.event,
                            projectionOrder: try DomainProjectionOrder(
                                authority: .acceptedAwaitingReplay,
                                ledgerPartitionId: nil,
                                ledgerPosition: nil,
                                sourceOrdinal: input.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal
                            )
                        )
                    }
                    state.outbox.remove(at: index)
                case .deferred:
                    state.outbox[index].receipt = receipt
                case .rejectedPermanent:
                    var dead = state.outbox.remove(at: index)
                    dead.receipt = receipt
                    dead.deadLetterReason = receipt.reasonCode?.rawValue
                        ?? "rejected_permanent"
                    state.receipts[storageKey] = receipt
                    state.deadLetters.append(dead)
                    state.localProjectionInputs.removeAll {
                        (try? $0.event.eventIdentity()) == slot.eventIdentity
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`EventWriteResponseValidator.validate(rawResponse:request:)` 是 `ValidatedEventWriteResponse` 的唯一 initializer owner。它重新计算 request body SHA-256、验证 generated `EventWriteResponseV2` schema、运行上述 exact roster rules，并把 immutable prepared request 放进 capability。`DomainLedgerStore.apply` 不公开接受裸 `EventWriteResponseV2` 或 `[EventReceipt]` 的 overload；tests 通过 symbol scan 保住这一边界。Task 5 的 `EventReceiptStore.swift` 与旧单条 `apply(receipt:)` tests 在本 task 删除，完整替换为：exact success roster、nullable raw-reject slot、missing/extra/reordered receipt、wrong top-level hash/count、identity/hash mismatch、success coordinate 缺失、non-success 伪造 coordinate，以及“任一 validation failure 后 outbox byte-for-byte 未变且记录 transport anomaly”的 batch tests。

`generate_contracts.py` 同时生成 `GeneratedContractValidators.validateEventWriteResponse(_:)`；该入口先做 duplicate-key/unknown-key/type/enum/pattern 检查，再允许 decode。production validator 的完整 gate 为：

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/EventWriteResponseValidator.swift
import CryptoKit
import Foundation

public enum EventWriteResponseValidationError: Error, Equatable {
    case requestEvidenceMismatch
    case responseRosterMismatch
    case responseSlotMismatch(Int)
    case illegalReceiptShape(Int)
}

public enum EventWriteResponseValidator {
    public static func validate(
        rawResponse: Data,
        request: PreparedEventWriteRequest
    ) throws -> ValidatedEventWriteResponse {
        let requestBodySha256 = SHA256.hash(data: request.body)
            .map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
        guard requestBodySha256 == request.requestBodySha256 else {
            throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.requestEvidenceMismatch
        }
        try GeneratedContractValidators.validateEventWriteResponse(rawResponse)
        let response = try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
            EventWriteResponseV2.self,
            from: rawResponse
        )
        guard response.schema == "ai-caddie-event-write-response-v2",
              response.requestHash == request.requestHash,
              response.requestBodySha256 == request.requestBodySha256,
              response.eventCount == request.slots.count,
              response.receipts.count == request.slots.count,
              response.receipts.map(\.inputIndex) == Array(0..<request.slots.count) else {
            throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.responseRosterMismatch
        }
        for (index, pair) in zip(request.slots, response.receipts).enumerated() {
            let (slot, receipt) = pair
            guard receipt.eventId == slot.event.eventId else {
                throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.responseSlotMismatch(index)
            }
            if let identity = receipt.eventIdentity {
                guard identity == slot.eventIdentity,
                      receipt.eventHash == slot.eventHash else {
                    throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.responseSlotMismatch(index)
                }
            } else {
                guard receipt.status == .rejectedPermanent else {
                    throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.illegalReceiptShape(index)
                }
                if receipt.reasonCode?.rawValue == "identity_envelope_mismatch" {
                    guard receipt.eventHash == slot.eventHash else {
                        throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.responseSlotMismatch(index)
                    }
                } else if receipt.eventHash != nil {
                    throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.illegalReceiptShape(index)
                }
            }
            let appended = [.accepted, .acceptedOpaque, .duplicateHashMatch]
                .contains(receipt.status)
            let coordinateComplete = receipt.ledgerPartitionId != nil
                && receipt.ledgerEpoch != nil
                && receipt.streamId != nil
                && receipt.ledgerPosition != nil
            let coordinateAbsent = receipt.ledgerPartitionId == nil
                && receipt.ledgerEpoch == nil
                && receipt.streamId == nil
                && receipt.ledgerPosition == nil
            guard appended ? coordinateComplete : coordinateAbsent else {
                throw EventWriteResponseValidationError.illegalReceiptShape(index)
            }
        }
        return ValidatedEventWriteResponse(response: response, request: request)
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/StrictJSONDecoder.swift
import Foundation

public enum StrictJSONError: Error, Equatable { case duplicateKey(String) }

public enum StrictJSONDecoder {
    private struct Frame {
        let object: Bool
        var keys: Set<String> = []
        var expectsKey: Bool
    }

    public static func decode<T: Decodable>(_ type: T.Type, from data: Data) throws -> T {
        try rejectDuplicateKeys(in: data)
        return try JSONDecoder().decode(type, from: data)
    }

    private static func rejectDuplicateKeys(in data: Data) throws {
        let bytes = Array(data)
        var stack: [Frame] = []
        var index = 0
        while index < bytes.count {
            switch bytes[index] {
            case 0x7b:
                stack.append(Frame(object: true, expectsKey: true)); index += 1
            case 0x5b:
                stack.append(Frame(object: false, expectsKey: false)); index += 1
            case 0x7d, 0x5d:
                if !stack.isEmpty { stack.removeLast() }; index += 1
            case 0x2c:
                if !stack.isEmpty && stack[stack.count - 1].object {
                    stack[stack.count - 1].expectsKey = true
                }
                index += 1
            case 0x22:
                let start = index
                index += 1
                var escaped = false
                while index < bytes.count {
                    let byte = bytes[index]
                    if escaped { escaped = false }
                    else if byte == 0x5c { escaped = true }
                    else if byte == 0x22 { break }
                    index += 1
                }
                let end = index
                if !stack.isEmpty && stack[stack.count - 1].object && stack[stack.count - 1].expectsKey {
                    let keyData = Data(bytes[start...end])
                    let key = try JSONDecoder().decode(String.self, from: keyData)
                    if stack[stack.count - 1].keys.contains(key) { throw StrictJSONError.duplicateKey(key) }
                    stack[stack.count - 1].keys.insert(key)
                    stack[stack.count - 1].expectsKey = false
                }
                index += 1
            default:
                index += 1
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/CanonicalJSON.swift
import CryptoKit
import Foundation

public enum CanonicalJSONError: Error { case nonNFC, negativeZero, unsafeInteger, unsupported }

public enum CanonicalJSON {
    private static let safeInteger: Int64 = 9_007_199_254_740_991

    private static func foundation(_ value: JSONValue) throws -> Any {
        switch value {
        case .null: return NSNull()
        case .bool(let value): return NSNumber(value: value)
        case .integer(let value):
            guard value >= -safeInteger && value <= safeInteger else { throw CanonicalJSONError.unsafeInteger }
            return NSNumber(value: value)
        case .number(let value):
            guard value.isFinite else { throw CanonicalJSONError.unsupported }
            guard !(value == 0 && value.sign == .minus) else { throw CanonicalJSONError.negativeZero }
            guard value.rounded(.towardZero) != value || abs(value) <= Double(safeInteger) else { throw CanonicalJSONError.unsafeInteger }
            return NSNumber(value: value)
        case .string(let value):
            guard value.precomposedStringWithCanonicalMapping == value else { throw CanonicalJSONError.nonNFC }
            return value
        case .array(let values): return try values.map(foundation)
        case .object(let values):
            var result: [String: Any] = [:]
            for (key, child) in values {
                guard key.precomposedStringWithCanonicalMapping == key else { throw CanonicalJSONError.nonNFC }
                result[key] = try foundation(child)
            }
            return result
        }
    }

    public static func data(_ value: JSONValue) throws -> Data {
        try JSONCanonicalization.data(withJSONObject: foundation(value))
    }

    public static func data<T: Encodable>(_ value: T) throws -> Data {
        let encoded = try JSONEncoder().encode(value)
        return try data(JSONDecoder().decode(JSONValue.self, from: encoded))
    }

    public static func number(_ value: Double) throws -> String {
        if value == 0 && value.sign == .minus { throw CanonicalJSONError.negativeZero }
        return try _serializeNumber(value)
    }
}

public enum TypedID {
    public static func make(domain: String, value: JSONValue) throws -> String {
        try make(domain: domain, canonicalBytes: CanonicalJSON.data(value))
    }

    public static func make<T: Encodable>(domain: String, value: T) throws -> String {
        try make(domain: domain, canonicalBytes: CanonicalJSON.data(value))
    }

    private static func make(domain: String, canonicalBytes: Data) throws -> String {
        var bytes = Data(domain.utf8); bytes.append(0); bytes.append(canonicalBytes)
        return SHA256.hash(data: bytes).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
    }
}
```
