```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/DomainRoundReducer.swift
import Foundation

public enum DomainReducerError: Error, Equatable {
    case invalidPayload(String)
    case invalidProjectionOrder
    case identityEnvelopeMismatch
    case duplicateIdentity
    case duplicateCoordinate
    case missingCause
    case canonicalDependsOnProvisional
    case unresolvedBaseDependency
    case projectionDependencyCycle
}

private enum EntityMutationOutcome: Equatable { case applied, noOp, conflict }

private struct ReducerEntityState {
    var value: JSONValue
    var revision: EntityRevisionToken
    var contributors: Set<String>
}

private struct ReducerNode {
    let key: String
    let identity: String
    let eventHash: String
    let input: DomainProjectionInput
}

private extension Dictionary where Key == String, Value == JSONValue {
    func required(_ key: String) throws -> JSONValue {
        guard let value = self[key] else { throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(key) }
        return value
    }

    func string(_ key: String) throws -> String {
        guard case .string(let value) = try required(key), !value.isEmpty else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(key)
        }
        return value
    }

    func int(_ key: String) throws -> Int {
        switch try required(key) {
        case .integer(let value): return Int(value)
        case .number(let value) where value.rounded(.towardZero) == value: return Int(value)
        default: throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(key)
        }
    }

    func double(_ key: String) throws -> Double {
        switch try required(key) {
        case .integer(let value): return Double(value)
        case .number(let value): return value
        default: throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(key)
        }
    }

    func nullableDouble(_ key: String) throws -> Double? {
        guard let value = self[key] else { return nil }
        switch value {
        case .null: return nil
        case .integer(let number): return Double(number)
        case .number(let number): return number
        default: throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(key)
        }
    }

    func object(_ key: String) throws -> [String: JSONValue] {
        guard case .object(let value) = try required(key) else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(key)
        }
        return value
    }
}

private extension JSONValue {
    var isUnset: Bool { self == .object(["state": .string("unset")]) }
}

private struct MutableDomainProjection {
    var lifecycle = "draft"
    var holes: [String: DomainHoleProjection] = [:]
    var shots: [String: DomainShotProjection] = [:]
    var shotTargets: [String: DomainShotTargetProjection] = [:]
    var flagPositions: [String: DomainFlagPositionProjection] = [:]
    var resolutions: [String: String] = [:]
    var resolutionScopes: [String: String] = [:]
    var mergeControl: [String: JSONValue]?
    var conflicts: [DomainConflict] = []
    var entities: [String: ReducerEntityState] = [:]
    private var applyingAuthority: ProjectionAuthority?

    private func projectionHash(_ value: JSONValue) throws -> String {
        try TypedID.make(domain: "EntityProjection/v1", value: .object(["value": value]))
    }

    private func eventSetHash(_ identities: Set<String>) throws -> String {
        try TypedID.make(
            domain: "ContributingEventSet/v1",
            value: .object(["eventIds": .array(identities.sorted().map { .string($0) })])
        )
    }

    private func absent(_ scopeId: String) throws -> ReducerEntityState {
        ReducerEntityState(
            value: .null,
            revision: EntityRevisionToken(
                scopeId: scopeId,
                reducerVersion: "round-reducer-v2",
                canonicalOrdinal: 0,
                entityProjectionHash: try projectionHash(.null),
                contributingEventSetHash: try eventSetHash(Set<String>()),
                provisionalFlag: true
            ),
            contributors: []
        )
    }

    private func equivalent(_ provided: EntityRevisionToken, _ current: EntityRevisionToken) -> Bool {
        provided.scopeId == current.scopeId
            && provided.reducerVersion == current.reducerVersion
            && provided.entityProjectionHash == current.entityProjectionHash
            && provided.contributingEventSetHash == current.contributingEventSetHash
    }

    private mutating func appendConflict(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        reasonCode: String,
        current override: ReducerEntityState? = nil
    ) throws {
        let current = override ?? entities[event.entityRef] ?? (try absent(event.entityRef))
        conflicts.append(DomainConflict(
            entityRef: event.entityRef,
            eventId: event.eventId,
            eventIdentity: try event.eventIdentity(),
            currentRevision: current.revision,
            providedBase: event.baseEntityRevision,
            reasonCode: reasonCode
        ))
    }

    private mutating func mutateEntity(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        value: JSONValue
    ) throws -> EntityMutationOutcome {
        if value.isUnset { return .noOp }
        guard let applyingAuthority else { throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder }
        let current = entities[event.entityRef] ?? (try absent(event.entityRef))
        guard let provided = event.baseEntityRevision, equivalent(provided, current.revision) else {
            try appendConflict(event, reasonCode: "entity_base_revision_conflict", current: current)
            return .conflict
        }
        var contributors = current.contributors
        contributors.insert(try event.eventIdentity())
        entities[event.entityRef] = ReducerEntityState(
            value: value,
            revision: EntityRevisionToken(
                scopeId: event.entityRef,
                reducerVersion: "round-reducer-v2",
                canonicalOrdinal: current.revision.canonicalOrdinal
                    + (applyingAuthority == .canonicalReplay ? 1 : 0),
                entityProjectionHash: try projectionHash(value),
                contributingEventSetHash: try eventSetHash(contributors),
                provisionalFlag: applyingAuthority != .canonicalReplay
            ),
            contributors: contributors
        )
        return .applied
    }

    private mutating func createEntity(_ event: DomainRoundEvent, value: JSONValue) throws -> Bool {
        guard let applyingAuthority else { throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder }
        if let current = entities[event.entityRef] {
            try appendConflict(event, reasonCode: "shot_identity_conflict", current: current)
            return false
        }
        let identity = try event.eventIdentity()
        let contributors: Set<String> = [identity]
        entities[event.entityRef] = ReducerEntityState(
            value: value,
            revision: EntityRevisionToken(
                scopeId: event.entityRef,
                reducerVersion: "round-reducer-v2",
                canonicalOrdinal: applyingAuthority == .canonicalReplay ? 1 : 0,
                entityProjectionHash: try projectionHash(value),
                contributingEventSetHash: try eventSetHash(contributors),
                provisionalFlag: applyingAuthority != .canonicalReplay
            ),
            contributors: contributors
        )
        return true
    }

    private mutating func applyLifecycle(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        let targets = [
            "round_started": "active", "round_suspended": "suspended",
            "round_resumed": "active", "round_finished": "finished",
            "round_discarded": "discarded",
        ]
        let legal: [String: Set<String>] = [
            "draft": ["round_started"],
            "active": ["round_suspended", "round_finished", "round_discarded"],
            "suspended": ["round_resumed", "round_finished", "round_discarded"],
            "finished": [], "discarded": [],
        ]
        guard let target = targets[event.kind.rawValue], legal[lifecycle, default: []].contains(event.kind.rawValue) else {
            try appendConflict(event, reasonCode: "illegal_lifecycle_transition")
            return
        }
        if event.kind.rawValue == "round_started" {
            lifecycle = target
            return
        }
        if try mutateEntity(event, value: .string(target)) == .applied { lifecycle = target }
    }

    private mutating func applyHoleFact(
        _ event: DomainRoundEvent,
        payloadKey: String,
        field: String
    ) throws {
        let hole = try event.payload.int("hole")
        let value = try event.payload.required(payloadKey)
        guard try mutateEntity(event, value: value) == .applied else { return }
        let key = String(hole)
        let old = holes[key] ?? DomainHoleProjection(score: nil, putts: nil, penalties: nil, fairway: nil)
        switch field {
        case "score": holes[key] = DomainHoleProjection(score: try event.payload.int(payloadKey), putts: old.putts, penalties: old.penalties, fairway: old.fairway)
        case "putts": holes[key] = DomainHoleProjection(score: old.score, putts: try event.payload.int(payloadKey), penalties: old.penalties, fairway: old.fairway)
        case "penalties": holes[key] = DomainHoleProjection(score: old.score, putts: old.putts, penalties: try event.payload.int(payloadKey), fairway: old.fairway)
        case "fairway": holes[key] = DomainHoleProjection(score: old.score, putts: old.putts, penalties: old.penalties, fairway: try event.payload.string(payloadKey))
        default: throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload(field)
        }
    }

    private mutating func applyFlagPosition(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        let hole = try event.payload.int("hole")
        let latitude = try event.payload.double("latitude")
        let longitude = try event.payload.double("longitude")
        guard (1...18).contains(hole),
              (-90...90).contains(latitude), (-180...180).contains(longitude),
              try event.payload.string("provenance") == "player_set" else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload("flag_position_not_player_set")
        }
        guard try mutateEntity(event, value: .object(event.payload)) == .applied else { return }
        flagPositions[String(hole)] = DomainFlagPositionProjection(
            hole: hole,
            latitude: latitude,
            longitude: longitude,
            provenance: "player_set"
        )
    }

    private mutating func applyShotTarget(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        let shotId = try event.payload.string("shotId")
        let provenance = try event.payload.string("provenance")
        let latitude = try event.payload.double("latitude")
        let longitude = try event.payload.double("longitude")
        guard ["player_confirmed", "explicit_touch_target"].contains(provenance),
              (-90...90).contains(latitude), (-180...180).contains(longitude) else {
            throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload("shot_target_not_player_confirmed")
        }
        let value: JSONValue = .object([
            "shotId": .string(shotId),
            "targetRef": .string(try event.payload.string("targetRef")),
            "latitude": .number(latitude),
            "longitude": .number(longitude),
            "provenance": .string(provenance),
            "retracted": .bool(false),
        ])
        guard try mutateEntity(event, value: value) == .applied else { return }
        shotTargets[shotId] = DomainShotTargetProjection(
            shotId: shotId,
            targetRef: try event.payload.string("targetRef"),
            latitude: latitude,
            longitude: longitude,
            provenance: provenance,
            orphaned: shots[shotId] == nil,
            retracted: false
        )
    }

    private mutating func retractShotTarget(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        let shotId = try event.payload.string("shotId")
        guard var target = shotTargets[shotId], let entity = entities[event.entityRef], case .object(var value) = entity.value else {
            try appendConflict(event, reasonCode: "shot_target_orphaned")
            return
        }
        value["retracted"] = .bool(true)
        guard try mutateEntity(event, value: .object(value)) == .applied else { return }
        target = DomainShotTargetProjection(
            shotId: target.shotId, targetRef: target.targetRef,
            latitude: target.latitude, longitude: target.longitude,
            provenance: target.provenance, orphaned: target.orphaned, retracted: true
        )
        shotTargets[shotId] = target
    }

    private mutating func recordShot(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        let shotId = try event.payload.string("shotId")
        if shots[shotId] != nil {
            try appendConflict(event, reasonCode: "shot_identity_conflict")
            return
        }
        let horizontal = try event.payload.nullableDouble("horizontalAccuracyM")
        let value: JSONValue = .object([
            "shotId": .string(shotId), "hole": .integer(Int64(try event.payload.int("hole"))),
            "latitude": .number(try event.payload.double("latitude")),
            "longitude": .number(try event.payload.double("longitude")),
            "horizontalAccuracyM": horizontal.map { .number($0) } ?? .null,
            "lie": .string(try event.payload.string("lie")),
            "provenance": .string(try event.payload.string("provenance")),
            "retracted": .bool(false),
        ])
        guard try createEntity(event, value: value) else { return }
        shots[shotId] = DomainShotProjection(
            shotId: shotId, hole: try event.payload.int("hole"),
            latitude: try event.payload.double("latitude"), longitude: try event.payload.double("longitude"),
            horizontalAccuracyM: horizontal, lie: try event.payload.string("lie"),
            provenance: try event.payload.string("provenance"), actualClubId: nil, retracted: false
        )
        if let target = shotTargets[shotId] {
            shotTargets[shotId] = DomainShotTargetProjection(
                shotId: target.shotId, targetRef: target.targetRef,
                latitude: target.latitude, longitude: target.longitude,
                provenance: target.provenance, orphaned: false, retracted: target.retracted
            )
        }
    }

    private mutating func correctShot(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        let shotId = try event.payload.string("shotId")
        guard let shot = shots[shotId], let current = entities[event.entityRef], case .object(var value) = current.value else {
            try appendConflict(event, reasonCode: "shot_identity_conflict")
            return
        }
        let patch = try event.payload.object("patch")
        for (key, child) in patch { value[key] = child }
        guard try mutateEntity(event, value: .object(value)) == .applied else { return }
        let horizontal = patch["horizontalAccuracyM"] == nil
            ? shot.horizontalAccuracyM
            : try patch.nullableDouble("horizontalAccuracyM")
        let latitude: Double
        if patch["latitude"] != nil { latitude = try patch.double("latitude") } else { latitude = shot.latitude }
        let longitude: Double
        if patch["longitude"] != nil { longitude = try patch.double("longitude") } else { longitude = shot.longitude }
        let lie: String
        if patch["lie"] != nil { lie = try patch.string("lie") } else { lie = shot.lie }
        let provenance: String
        if patch["provenance"] != nil { provenance = try patch.string("provenance") } else { provenance = shot.provenance }
        shots[shotId] = DomainShotProjection(
            shotId: shot.shotId, hole: shot.hole,
            latitude: latitude,
            longitude: longitude,
            horizontalAccuracyM: horizontal,
            lie: lie,
            provenance: provenance,
            actualClubId: shot.actualClubId, retracted: shot.retracted
        )
    }

    private mutating func retractShot(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        let shotId = try event.payload.string("shotId")
        guard let shot = shots[shotId], let current = entities[event.entityRef], case .object(var value) = current.value else {
            try appendConflict(event, reasonCode: "shot_identity_conflict")
            return
        }
        value["retracted"] = .bool(true)
        guard try mutateEntity(event, value: .object(value)) == .applied else { return }
        shots[shotId] = DomainShotProjection(
            shotId: shot.shotId, hole: shot.hole, latitude: shot.latitude, longitude: shot.longitude,
            horizontalAccuracyM: shot.horizontalAccuracyM, lie: shot.lie, provenance: shot.provenance,
            actualClubId: shot.actualClubId, retracted: true
        )
    }

    private mutating func setActualClub(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        let shotId = try event.payload.string("shotId")
        guard let shot = shots[shotId] else {
            try appendConflict(event, reasonCode: "shot_identity_conflict")
            return
        }
        let value = try event.payload.required("clubId")
        guard try mutateEntity(event, value: value) == .applied else { return }
        let clubId: String?
        switch value {
        case .null: clubId = nil
        case .string(let value): clubId = value
        default: throw DomainReducerError.invalidPayload("clubId")
        }
        shots[shotId] = DomainShotProjection(
            shotId: shot.shotId, hole: shot.hole, latitude: shot.latitude, longitude: shot.longitude,
            horizontalAccuracyM: shot.horizontalAccuracyM, lie: shot.lie, provenance: shot.provenance,
            actualClubId: clubId, retracted: shot.retracted
        )
    }

    private mutating func openResolution(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        let resolutionId = try event.payload.string("resolutionId")
        let scopeId = try event.payload.string("scopeId")
        guard resolutions[resolutionId] == nil else {
            try appendConflict(event, reasonCode: "resolution_episode_conflict")
            return
        }
        let sameScopeNonterminal = resolutionScopes.compactMap { candidateId, candidateScope in
            guard candidateScope == scopeId,
                  let state = resolutions[candidateId],
                  Set(["active", "conflicted"]).contains(state) else { return nil }
            return candidateId
        }.sorted()
        guard try mutateEntity(
            event,
            value: .object(["state": .string("active"), "scopeId": .string(scopeId)])
        ) == .applied else { return }
        resolutions[resolutionId] = sameScopeNonterminal.isEmpty ? "active" : "conflicted"
        for candidateId in sameScopeNonterminal { resolutions[candidateId] = "conflicted" }
        resolutionScopes[resolutionId] = scopeId
        if !sameScopeNonterminal.isEmpty {
            try appendConflict(event, reasonCode: "resolution_episode_conflict")
        }
    }

    private mutating func closeResolution(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        let resolutionId = try event.payload.string("resolutionId")
        guard resolutions[resolutionId] == "active", let scopeId = resolutionScopes[resolutionId] else {
            try appendConflict(event, reasonCode: "resolution_episode_conflict")
            return
        }
        let disposition = try event.payload.string("disposition")
        guard try mutateEntity(
            event,
            value: .object(["state": .string(disposition), "scopeId": .string(scopeId)])
        ) == .applied else { return }
        resolutions[resolutionId] = disposition
    }

    private mutating func applyMergeControl(_ event: DomainRoundEvent) throws {
        let revision = try event.payload.int("revision")
        if let current = mergeControl {
            if try current.int("revision") >= revision {
                try appendConflict(event, reasonCode: "entity_base_revision_conflict")
                return
            }
        }
        guard try mutateEntity(event, value: .object(event.payload)) == .applied else { return }
        mergeControl = event.payload
    }

    mutating func apply(_ input: DomainProjectionInput) throws {
        guard applyingAuthority == nil else { throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder }
        applyingAuthority = input.projectionOrder.authority
        defer { applyingAuthority = nil }
        let event = input.event
        switch event.kind.rawValue {
        case "round_started", "round_suspended", "round_resumed", "round_finished", "round_discarded":
            try applyLifecycle(event)
        case "hole_score_set": try applyHoleFact(event, payloadKey: "strokes", field: "score")
        case "putts_set": try applyHoleFact(event, payloadKey: "putts", field: "putts")
        case "penalties_set": try applyHoleFact(event, payloadKey: "penalties", field: "penalties")
        case "fairway_set": try applyHoleFact(event, payloadKey: "fairway", field: "fairway")
        case "flag_position_set": try applyFlagPosition(event)
        case "shot_target_set": try applyShotTarget(event)
        case "shot_target_retracted": try retractShotTarget(event)
        case "shot_recorded": try recordShot(event)
        case "shot_fact_corrected": try correctShot(event)
        case "shot_retracted": try retractShot(event)
        case "actual_club_set": try setActualClub(event)
        case "resolution_opened": try openResolution(event)
        case "resolution_closed": try closeResolution(event)
        case "round_merge_resolution": try applyMergeControl(event)
        default: break
        }
    }

    func freeze(replication: DomainReplicationContext) -> DomainRoundProjection {
        let replicationState = !conflicts.isEmpty ? "conflict"
            : replication.deadLetterCount > 0 ? "deadLetter"
            : replication.syncing ? "syncing"
            : (replication.pendingCount > 0
               || replication.awaitingCanonicalReplayCount > 0) ? "dirty" : "clean"
        return DomainRoundProjection(
            lifecycle: lifecycle,
            replication: replicationState,
            holes: holes,
            shots: shots,
            shotTargets: shotTargets,
            flagPositions: flagPositions,
            resolutions: resolutions,
            mergeControl: mergeControl,
            conflicts: conflicts,
            entityRevisions: entities.mapValues(\.revision)
        )
    }
}

public struct DomainRoundReducer {
    public init() {}

    private func ordered(
        _ inputs: [DomainProjectionInput],
        knownCauseIdentities: Set<String>
    ) throws -> [DomainProjectionInput] {
        let authorityRank: [ProjectionAuthority: Int] = [
            .peerProvisional: 0,
            .localPreparedResolutionCommit: 1,
            .localProvisional: 2,
            .acceptedAwaitingReplay: 3,
            .canonicalReplay: 4,
        ]
        var selected: [String: ReducerNode] = [:]
        var canonicalCoordinates: Set<String> = []
        var canonicalIdentities: Set<String> = []
        for input in inputs {
            try RoundPayloadValidator.validate(input.event)
            let identity = try input.event.eventIdentity()
            let eventHash = try input.event.eventHash()
            let node = ReducerNode(
                key: identity, identity: identity,
                eventHash: eventHash, input: input
            )
            if input.projectionOrder.authority == .canonicalReplay {
                guard let partition = input.projectionOrder.ledgerPartitionId,
                      let position = input.projectionOrder.ledgerPosition else {
                    throw DomainReducerError.invalidProjectionOrder
                }
                guard canonicalCoordinates.insert("\(partition):\(position.rawValue)").inserted else {
                    throw DomainReducerError.duplicateCoordinate
                }
                guard canonicalIdentities.insert(identity).inserted else {
                    throw DomainReducerError.duplicateIdentity
                }
            }
            if let prior = selected[identity] {
                guard prior.eventHash == eventHash else {
                    throw DomainReducerError.identityEnvelopeMismatch
                }
                let priorAuthority = prior.input.projectionOrder.authority
                let authority = input.projectionOrder.authority
                if priorAuthority == .canonicalReplay && authority == .canonicalReplay {
                    throw DomainReducerError.duplicateIdentity
                }
                if priorAuthority != .canonicalReplay,
                   authority != .canonicalReplay,
                   priorAuthority == authority {
                    throw DomainReducerError.duplicateIdentity
                }
                if authorityRank[authority, default: -1]
                    > authorityRank[priorAuthority, default: -1] {
                    selected[identity] = node
                }
            } else {
                selected[identity] = node
            }
        }
        let nodes = selected
        var incoming = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: nodes.keys.map { ($0, 0) })
        var outgoing = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: nodes.keys.map { ($0, Set<String>()) })
        func addEdge(_ before: String, _ after: String) {
            guard before != after, outgoing[before]?.contains(after) == false else { return }
            outgoing[before, default: []].insert(after)
            incoming[after, default: 0] += 1
        }
        for node in nodes.values {
            let event = node.input.event
            let base = event.baseEntityRevision
            let emptyEventSetHash = try TypedID.make(
                domain: "ContributingEventSet/v1",
                value: .object(["eventIds": .array([])])
            )
            if let base,
               (base.canonicalOrdinal > 0
                || base.contributingEventSetHash != emptyEventSetHash),
               event.causationId == nil {
                throw DomainReducerError.unresolvedBaseDependency
            }
            if let causationId = event.causationId {
                if let cause = nodes[causationId] {
                    if node.input.projectionOrder.authority == .canonicalReplay,
                       cause.input.projectionOrder.authority != .canonicalReplay {
                        throw DomainReducerError.canonicalDependsOnProvisional
                    }
                    addEdge(cause.key, node.key)
                } else if !knownCauseIdentities.contains(causationId) {
                    throw DomainReducerError.missingCause
                }
            }
        }
        let canonicalNodes = nodes.values.filter {
            $0.input.projectionOrder.authority == .canonicalReplay
        }
        for rows in Dictionary(grouping: canonicalNodes, by: {
            $0.input.projectionOrder.ledgerPartitionId!
        }).values {
            let sorted = rows.sorted {
                let left = $0.input.projectionOrder.ledgerPosition!
                let right = $1.input.projectionOrder.ledgerPosition!
                return left == right ? $0.key < $1.key : left < right
            }
            for pair in zip(sorted, sorted.dropFirst()) { addEdge(pair.0.key, pair.1.key) }
        }
        func comesBefore(_ lhs: ReducerNode, _ rhs: ReducerNode) -> Bool {
            let lhsCanonical = lhs.input.projectionOrder.authority == .canonicalReplay ? 0 : 1
            let rhsCanonical = rhs.input.projectionOrder.authority == .canonicalReplay ? 0 : 1
            if lhsCanonical != rhsCanonical { return lhsCanonical < rhsCanonical }
            if lhs.input.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal != rhs.input.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal {
                return lhs.input.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal < rhs.input.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal
            }
            if lhs.identity != rhs.identity { return lhs.identity < rhs.identity }
            return lhs.eventHash < rhs.eventHash
        }
        var ready = incoming.compactMap { $0.value == 0 ? $0.key : nil }
        var result: [DomainProjectionInput] = []
        while !ready.isEmpty {
            ready.sort { comesBefore(nodes[$0]!, nodes[$1]!) }
            let key = ready.removeFirst()
            result.append(nodes[key]!.input)
            for target in outgoing[key, default: []].sorted() {
                incoming[target, default: 0] -= 1
                if incoming[target] == 0 { ready.append(target) }
            }
        }
        guard result.count == nodes.count else { throw DomainReducerError.projectionDependencyCycle }
        return result
    }

    public func reduce(
        _ inputs: [DomainProjectionInput],
        replication: DomainReplicationContext
    ) throws -> DomainRoundProjection {
        var state = MutableDomainProjection()
        for input in try ordered(
            inputs,
            knownCauseIdentities: replication.canonicalPrefixEventIdentities
        ) { try state.apply(input) }
        return state.freeze(replication: replication)
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieTests/OfflineStoreTests.swift
func testLegacyEventsMigrateOnceWithoutSyncMarkers() throws {
    let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
    addTeardownBlock { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory) }
    try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: directory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
    let legacy = directory.appendingPathComponent("events.jsonl")
    let lines = [
        #"{"eventId":"score-1","roundId":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","timestamp":"2026-07-18T00:00:00Z","hole":1,"kind":"score","payload":{"strokes":4}}"#,
        #"{"eventId":"marker-1","roundId":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","timestamp":"2026-07-18T00:00:01Z","hole":0,"kind":"sync_marker","payload":{"status":"synced"}}"#,
        #"{"eventId":"putt-1","roundId":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","timestamp":"2026-07-18T00:00:02Z","hole":1,"kind":"putt","payload":{"putts":2}}"#,
        #"{"eventId":"unbound-1","roundId":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","timestamp":"2026-07-18T00:00:03Z","hole":1,"kind":"score","payload":{"strokes":5}}"#,
        #"{"eventId":"invalid-1","roundId":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","timestamp":"2026-07-18T00:00:04Z","hole":1,"kind":"score","payload":{}}"#,
        #"{"eventId":"broken""#,
    ].joined(separator: "\n")
    try lines.write(to: legacy, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
    let store = try RoundLedgerMigration.migrateIfNeeded(
        legacyURL: legacy,
        domainURL: directory.appendingPathComponent("v2"),
        bindingsByRound: [
            "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111": .init(ownerAccountId: "acct-1", subjectPlayerId: "player-1", roundIntentId: "intent-1", roundIncarnationId: "inc-1", snapshotId: "snapshot-1", semanticBindingHash: "binding-1")
        ]
    )
    XCTAssertEqual(try store.allEvents().map(\.eventId), ["score-1", "putt-1"])
    XCTAssertEqual(try store.pendingEventIds(), ["score-1", "putt-1"])
    XCTAssertFalse(try store.allEvents().contains { $0.kind.rawValue == "sync_marker" })
    XCTAssertEqual(
        try store.migrationDeadLetters().map(\.reasonCode),
        ["legacy_migration_unmappable", "legacy_migration_invalid_payload", "legacy_migration_malformed"]
    )
}

func testLegacyMigrationBatchIsAtomicBeforeAndAfterReplace() throws {
    let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
    addTeardownBlock { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory) }
    try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: directory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
    let legacy = directory.appendingPathComponent("events.jsonl")
    try [
        #"{"eventId":"score-1","roundId":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","timestamp":"2026-07-18T00:00:00Z","hole":1,"kind":"score","payload":{"strokes":4}}"#,
        #"{"eventId":"broken""#,
    ].joined(separator: "\n").write(to: legacy, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
    let binding = LegacyMigrationBinding(
        ownerAccountId: "acct-1", subjectPlayerId: "player-1", roundIntentId: "intent-1",
        roundIncarnationId: "inc-1", snapshotId: "snapshot-1", semanticBindingHash: "binding-1"
    )
    let beforeURL = directory.appendingPathComponent("before")
    XCTAssertThrowsError(try RoundLedgerMigration.migrateIfNeeded(
        legacyURL: legacy,
        domainURL: beforeURL,
        bindingsByRound: ["11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111": binding],
        faultHook: { if $0 == .beforeAtomicReplace { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) } }
    ))
    let rolledBack = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: beforeURL)
    XCTAssertEqual(try rolledBack.allEvents(), [])
    XCTAssertEqual(try rolledBack.migrationDeadLetters(), [])
    XCTAssertFalse(rolledBack.hasMigrationMarker("ios-v1-events"))
    let retried = try RoundLedgerMigration.migrateIfNeeded(
        legacyURL: legacy, domainURL: beforeURL,
        bindingsByRound: ["11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111": binding]
    )
    XCTAssertEqual(try retried.allEvents().map(\.eventId), ["score-1"])
    XCTAssertEqual(try retried.migrationDeadLetters().map(\.reasonCode), ["legacy_migration_malformed"])

    let afterURL = directory.appendingPathComponent("after")
    XCTAssertThrowsError(try RoundLedgerMigration.migrateIfNeeded(
        legacyURL: legacy,
        domainURL: afterURL,
        bindingsByRound: ["11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111": binding],
        faultHook: { if $0 == .afterAtomicReplace { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) } }
    ))
    let committed = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: afterURL)
    XCTAssertEqual(try committed.allEvents().map(\.eventId), ["score-1"])
    XCTAssertEqual(try committed.migrationDeadLetters().count, 1)
    XCTAssertTrue(committed.hasMigrationMarker("ios-v1-events"))
}
```

```swift
private func fixtureDomainEvent(eventId: String, sequence: Int, kind: RoundEventKind, entityRef: String, payload: [String: JSONValue]) -> DomainRoundEvent {

        eventId: eventId, originDeviceId: "ios-1", originEpoch: "epoch-1", clientSequence: sequence,
        ownerAccountId: "acct-1", subjectPlayerId: "player-1", actorId: "player-1", roundId: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
        streamSubject: .roundIncarnation("inc-1"), roundIntentId: "intent-1", snapshotId: "snapshot-1",
        roundSemanticBindingHash: "binding-1", kind: kind, entityRef: entityRef, payload: payload,
        causationId: nil,
        baseEntityRevision: EntityRevisionToken(
            scopeId: entityRef, reducerVersion: "round-reducer-v2", canonicalOrdinal: 0,
            entityProjectionHash: "5962e33b3a81156e8b13eefca7d43d9592b3aed4e4bb1ba1dcfde8b58cb937bc",
            contributingEventSetHash: "1ae5b0e0cfebf650024a55ee57af8df5c190a1c20518d741e99babf22bf697be",
            provisionalFlag: true
        ),
        occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
    )
}

private struct MockRoundSyncTransport: RoundSyncTransport {
    let makeReceipts: @Sendable (PreparedEventWriteRequest) throws -> [EventReceipt]

    func post(_ request: PreparedEventWriteRequest) async throws -> ValidatedEventWriteResponse {
        let response = EventWriteResponseV2(
            schema: "ai-caddie-event-write-response-v2",
            requestHash: request.requestHash,
            requestBodySha256: request.requestBodySha256,
            eventCount: request.slots.count,
            receipts: try makeReceipts(request)
        )
        return try EventWriteResponseValidator.validate(
            rawResponse: CanonicalJSON.data(response),
            request: request
        )
    }
    func bootstrap(roundId: String, consumerEpoch: String) async throws -> DeviceSyncBootstrap {
        DeviceSyncBootstrap(
            roundId: roundId, consumerDeviceId: "ios-1", consumerEpoch: consumerEpoch,
            mergeControlGeneration: 0, mergeResolutionId: nil, streams: [],
            mergedCheckpointHash: "empty"
        )
    }
    func replay(roundId: String, stream: DeviceSyncStream, vectorGeneration: Int, after: CanonicalLedgerPosition, limit: Int) async throws -> DeviceReplayPage {
        DeviceReplayPage(
            ledgerPartitionId: stream.ledgerPartitionId, ledgerEpoch: stream.ledgerEpoch,
            streamId: stream.streamId, fromExclusive: after, throughInclusive: after,
            events: [], nextCursor: nil, hasMore: false,
            checkpointHash: stream.checkpointHash, ackCheckpointHash: "prefix-empty",
            mergeControlGeneration: vectorGeneration, mergeResolutionId: nil
        )
    }
    func ack(roundId: String, stream: DeviceSyncStream, vectorGeneration: Int, through position: CanonicalLedgerPosition, ackCheckpointHash: String, consumerEpoch: String) async throws {}
}

func testDeferredReceiptStaysPendingAndAcceptedReceiptIsRemoved() async throws {
    let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
    addTeardownBlock { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory) }
    let store = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: directory)
    let deferred = fixtureDomainEvent(eventId: "deferred", sequence: 1, kind: .puttsSet, entityRef: "round:11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111:hole:1:putts", payload: ["hole": .integer(1), "putts": .integer(2)])
    let accepted = fixtureDomainEvent(eventId: "accepted", sequence: 2, kind: .holeScoreSet, entityRef: "round:11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111:hole:1:score", payload: ["hole": .integer(1), "strokes": .integer(4)])
    try store.append(deferred)
    try store.append(accepted)
    let transport = MockRoundSyncTransport { request in [
        EventReceipt(eventId: request.slots[0].event.eventId, eventIdentity: request.slots[0].eventIdentity, eventHash: request.slots[0].eventHash, inputIndex: 0, status: .deferred, ledgerPartitionId: nil, ledgerEpoch: nil, streamId: nil, ledgerPosition: nil, currentEntityRevision: nil, reasonCode: nil),
        EventReceipt(eventId: request.slots[1].event.eventId, eventIdentity: request.slots[1].eventIdentity, eventHash: request.slots[1].eventHash, inputIndex: 1, status: .accepted, ledgerPartitionId: String(repeating: "a", count: 64), ledgerEpoch: 1, streamId: "s1", ledgerPosition: try CanonicalLedgerPosition("1"), currentEntityRevision: nil, reasonCode: nil),
    ] }
    let epochStore = try ConsumerEpochStore(url: directory.appendingPathComponent("consumer-epoch"))
    let client = try RoundLedgerSyncClient(
        baseURL: URL(string: "https://example.invalid")!, ledger: store,
        transport: transport, consumerEpochStore: epochStore,
        principal: RoundSyncPrincipal(
            ownerAccountId: "acct-1",
            subjectPlayerId: "player-1",
            actorId: "player-1"
        )
    )
    try await client.flushOutbox(roundId: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
    XCTAssertEqual(try store.pendingEventIds(), ["deferred"])
    let replication = try store.replicationContext(
        roundId: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
    )
    XCTAssertEqual(replication.awaitingCanonicalReplayCount, 1)
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieTests/DomainLedgerInboundVectorTests.swift
@testable import AICaddieDomain
import XCTest
@testable import AICaddie

final class DomainLedgerInboundVectorTests: XCTestCase {
    private let roundId = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
    private let principal = RoundSyncPrincipal(
        ownerAccountId: "acct-1",
        subjectPlayerId: "player-1",
        actorId: "player-1"
    )

    private func partitionId(_ label: String) -> String {
        String(repeating: label == "a" ? "a" : label == "b" ? "b" : "c", count: 64)
    }

    private func stream(_ partition: String, ordinal: Int) -> DeviceSyncStream {
        DeviceSyncStream(
            streamSubject: .roundIncarnation("inc-\(partition)"),
            ledgerPartitionId: partitionId(partition), ledgerEpoch: 1, streamId: "stream-\(partition)",
            lastAckedPosition: try! CanonicalLedgerPosition("0"),
            replayCursor: try! CanonicalLedgerPosition("0"),
            checkpointHash: "head-\(partition)", sourceOrdinal: ordinal
        )
    }

    private func bootstrap(
        generation: Int,
        resolution: String,
        streams: [DeviceSyncStream],
        syncRoundId: String? = nil
    ) -> DeviceSyncBootstrap {
        DeviceSyncBootstrap(
            roundId: syncRoundId ?? roundId,
            consumerDeviceId: "ios-1", consumerEpoch: "epoch-1",
            mergeControlGeneration: generation, mergeResolutionId: resolution,
            streams: streams, mergedCheckpointHash: "merged-\(generation)"
        )
    }

    private func event(
        _ id: String,
        partition: String,
        ordinal: Int,
        eventRoundId: String? = nil
    ) -> DomainRoundEvent {
        let boundRoundId = eventRoundId ?? roundId
        return DomainRoundEvent(
            eventId: id, originDeviceId: "server", originEpoch: "epoch-1", clientSequence: 1,
            ownerAccountId: "acct-1", subjectPlayerId: "player-1", actorId: "player-1",
            roundId: boundRoundId, streamSubject: .roundIncarnation("inc-\(partition)"),
            roundIntentId: "intent-1", snapshotId: "snapshot-1",
            roundSemanticBindingHash: "binding-1", kind: .holeScoreSet,
            entityRef: "round:\(boundRoundId):hole:\(ordinal + 1):score",
            payload: ["hole": .integer(Int64(ordinal + 1)), "strokes": .integer(4)],
            causationId: nil,
            baseEntityRevision: .absent(scopeId: "round:\(boundRoundId):hole:\(ordinal + 1):score"),
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        )
    }

    private func started(partition: String, eventRoundId: String? = nil) -> DomainRoundEvent {
        let boundRoundId = eventRoundId ?? roundId
        return DomainRoundEvent(
            eventId: "start-\(partition)", originDeviceId: "server",
            originEpoch: "epoch-1", clientSequence: 1,
            ownerAccountId: "acct-1", subjectPlayerId: "player-1", actorId: "player-1",
            roundId: boundRoundId, streamSubject: .roundIncarnation("inc-\(partition)"),
            roundIntentId: "intent-1", snapshotId: "snapshot-1",
            roundSemanticBindingHash: "binding-1", kind: .roundStarted,
            entityRef: "round:\(boundRoundId)",
            payload: ["deviceRoundInstallBinding": .object([
                "deviceId": .string("server"),
                "installAckId": .string(String(repeating: "a", count: 64)),
                "installInstanceId": .string("install-1"),
                "installManifestId": .string("manifest-1"),
                "snapshotId": .string("snapshot-1"),
                "profileId": .string("watch-18"),
                "courseLayoutIdentityId": .string("layout-1"),
                "layoutRevisionId": .string("revision-1"),
                "teeSelectionId": .string("tee-1"),
                "liveRoundPackageId": .string("lrp-1"),
                "verifiedAt": .string("2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"),
            ])],
            causationId: nil, baseEntityRevision: nil,
            occurredAt: "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"
        )
    }

    private func page(
        stream: DeviceSyncStream,
        generation: Int,
        resolution: String,
        event: DomainRoundEvent?,
        from: Int = 0
    ) -> DeviceReplayPage {
        let events = event.map { value in
            [DomainProjectionInput(
                event: value,
                projectionOrder: try! DomainProjectionOrder(
                    authority: .canonicalReplay,
                    ledgerPartitionId: stream.ledgerPartitionId,
                    ledgerPosition: try! CanonicalLedgerPosition(String(from + 1)),
                    sourceOrdinal: stream.sourceOrdinal
                )
            )]
        } ?? []
        let through = event == nil ? from : from + 1
        return DeviceReplayPage(
            ledgerPartitionId: stream.ledgerPartitionId, ledgerEpoch: stream.ledgerEpoch,
            streamId: stream.streamId,
            fromExclusive: try! CanonicalLedgerPosition(String(from)),
            throughInclusive: try! CanonicalLedgerPosition(String(through)),
            events: events, nextCursor: nil, hasMore: false,
            checkpointHash: "head-\(stream.ledgerPartitionId)-\(through)",
            ackCheckpointHash: "prefix-\(generation)-\(stream.ledgerPartitionId)-\(through)",
            mergeControlGeneration: generation, mergeResolutionId: resolution
        )
    }

    func testUnmergeRemovesAAndRewritesRetainedBOrdinalAtomically() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        addTeardownBlock { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: root)
        let a = stream("a", ordinal: 0)
        let b = stream("b", ordinal: 1)
        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(generation: 1, resolution: "r1", streams: [a, b]))
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: a, generation: 1, resolution: "r1", event: started(partition: "a")), stream: a, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: a, generation: 1, resolution: "r1", event: event("a1", partition: "a", ordinal: 0), from: 1), stream: a, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: b, generation: 1, resolution: "r1", event: started(partition: "b")), stream: b, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: b, generation: 1, resolution: "r1", event: event("b1", partition: "b", ordinal: 1), from: 1), stream: b, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)

        let retainedB = stream("b", ordinal: 0)
        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(generation: 2, resolution: "r2", streams: [retainedB]))
        let inputs = try ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId).filter {
            $0.event.kind == .holeScoreSet
        }
        XCTAssertEqual(inputs.map { $0.event.eventId }, ["b1"])
        XCTAssertEqual(inputs.map { $0.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal }, [0])
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try ledger.inboundAckCheckpointHash(
            roundId: roundId, partitionId: retainedB.ledgerPartitionId, mergeControlGeneration: 1
        ))
    }

    func testReorderRewritesBothOrdinalsAndRejectsStaleGenerationPage() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        addTeardownBlock { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: root)
        let a = stream("a", ordinal: 0)
        let b = stream("b", ordinal: 1)
        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(generation: 7, resolution: "r7", streams: [a, b]))
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: a, generation: 7, resolution: "r7", event: started(partition: "a")), stream: a, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: a, generation: 7, resolution: "r7", event: event("a1", partition: "a", ordinal: 0), from: 1), stream: a, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: b, generation: 7, resolution: "r7", event: started(partition: "b")), stream: b, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)
        try ledger.persistInbound(page(stream: b, generation: 7, resolution: "r7", event: event("b1", partition: "b", ordinal: 1), from: 1), stream: b, roundId: roundId, principal: principal)

        let reorderedB = stream("b", ordinal: 0)
        let reorderedA = stream("a", ordinal: 1)
        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(generation: 8, resolution: "r8", streams: [reorderedB, reorderedA]))
        let byId = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: try ledger.projectionInputs(roundId: roundId).filter {
            $0.event.kind == .holeScoreSet
        }.map {
            ($0.event.eventId, $0.projectionOrder.sourceOrdinal)
        })
        XCTAssertEqual(byId, ["a1": 1, "b1": 0])
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(stream: a, generation: 7, resolution: "r7", event: nil, from: 2),
            stream: a, roundId: roundId, principal: principal
        ))

        // Replaying an empty page under generation 8 creates a fresh immutable
        // prefix token; the generation-7 token was cleared during adoption.
        try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(stream: reorderedA, generation: 8, resolution: "r8", event: nil, from: 2),
            stream: reorderedA, roundId: roundId, principal: principal
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try ledger.inboundAckCheckpointHash(
                roundId: roundId, partitionId: reorderedA.ledgerPartitionId, mergeControlGeneration: 8
            ),
            "prefix-8-\(reorderedA.ledgerPartitionId)-2"
        )
    }

    func testSamePartitionHasIndependentStandaloneAndMergedMaterializationCursors() throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString)
        addTeardownBlock { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let ledger = try DomainLedgerStore(directoryURL: root)
        let sourceRoundId = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
        let shared = stream("shared", ordinal: 0)

        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(
            generation: 0, resolution: "standalone", streams: [shared],
            syncRoundId: sourceRoundId
        ))
        try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(stream: shared, generation: 0, resolution: "standalone", event: started(partition: "shared", eventRoundId: sourceRoundId)),
            stream: shared, roundId: sourceRoundId, principal: principal
        )
        try ledger.persistInbound(
            page(stream: shared, generation: 0, resolution: "standalone", event: event("source-1", partition: "shared", ordinal: 0, eventRoundId: sourceRoundId), from: 1),
            stream: shared, roundId: sourceRoundId, principal: principal
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try ledger.inboundPersistedThrough(roundId: sourceRoundId, partitionId: shared.ledgerPartitionId),
            try CanonicalLedgerPosition("2")
        )

        // The server ACK is partition-scoped, but the merged projection has not
        // materialized this prefix yet and therefore must replay from zero.
        try ledger.adoptBootstrap(bootstrap(
            generation: 1, resolution: "merged-r1", streams: [shared]
        ))
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try ledger.inboundPersistedThrough(roundId: roundId, partitionId: shared.ledgerPartitionId),
            try CanonicalLedgerPosition("0")
        )
        XCTAssertEqual(
            try ledger.inboundPersistedThrough(roundId: sourceRoundId, partitionId: shared.ledgerPartitionId),
            try CanonicalLedgerPosition("2")
        )
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddie/Services/RoundLedgerMigration.swift
import AICaddieDomain
import Foundation

enum RoundLedgerMigration {
    static func migrateIfNeeded(
        legacyURL: URL,
        domainURL: URL,
        bindingsByRound: [String: LegacyMigrationBinding],
        faultHook: @escaping (DomainLedgerFaultPoint) throws -> Void = { _ in }
    ) throws -> DomainLedgerStore {
        let storageBindings = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: bindingsByRound.map { (roundId, binding) in
            (roundId, RoundEventContext(
                ownerAccountId: binding.ownerAccountId,
                subjectPlayerId: binding.subjectPlayerId,
                actorId: binding.subjectPlayerId,
                roundId: roundId,
                roundIntentId: binding.roundIntentId,
                roundIncarnationId: binding.roundIncarnationId,
                snapshotId: binding.snapshotId,
                semanticBindingHash: binding.semanticBindingHash,
                deviceRoundInstallBinding: .object([
                    "deviceId": .string("legacy-ios"),
                    "profileId": .string("ios-v1-migration"),
                    "installManifestId": .string("legacy-install-\(roundId)"),
                    "snapshotId": .string(binding.snapshotId),
                    "verifiedAt": .string("2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z"),
                ])
            ))
        })
        let store = try DomainLedgerCompositionRoot.open(
            directoryURL: domainURL,
            bindingsByRound: storageBindings,
            faultHook: faultHook
        )
        guard !store.hasMigrationMarker("ios-v1-events") else { return store }
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: legacyURL.path) else { return store }
        var builders: [String: LegacyRevisionBuilder] = [:]
        var pendingEvents: [DomainRoundEvent] = []
        var deadLetters: [MigrationDeadLetter] = []
        for record in try LegacyEventReader.read(url: legacyURL) {
            guard case .event(let legacy, let sourceLine, let raw) = record else {
                if case .malformed(let sourceLine, let raw) = record {
                    deadLetters.append(try MigrationDeadLetter.make(
                        sourceLine: sourceLine, eventId: nil, roundId: nil,
                        reasonCode: "legacy_migration_malformed", raw: raw
                    ))
                }
                continue
            }
            if legacy.isSyncMarker { continue }
            guard let binding = bindingsByRound[legacy.roundId] else {
                deadLetters.append(try MigrationDeadLetter.make(
                    sourceLine: sourceLine, eventId: legacy.eventId, roundId: legacy.roundId,
                    reasonCode: "legacy_migration_unmappable", raw: raw
                ))
                continue
            }
            var builder = builders[legacy.roundId] ?? LegacyRevisionBuilder(binding: binding)
            do {
                let domainEvent = try builder.convert(legacy, clientSequence: sourceLine)
                builders[legacy.roundId] = builder
                pendingEvents.append(domainEvent)
            } catch LegacyConversionError.invalidPayload {
                deadLetters.append(try MigrationDeadLetter.make(
                    sourceLine: sourceLine, eventId: legacy.eventId, roundId: legacy.roundId,
                    reasonCode: "legacy_migration_invalid_payload", raw: raw
                ))
            }
        }
        try store.importMigrationBatch(
            events: pendingEvents,
            deadLetters: deadLetters,
            marker: "ios-v1-events"
        )
        return store
    }
}

struct LegacyMigrationBinding {
    let ownerAccountId: String
    let subjectPlayerId: String
    let roundIntentId: String
    let roundIncarnationId: String
    let snapshotId: String
    let semanticBindingHash: String
}

private struct LegacyEvent: Decodable {
    let eventId: String
    let roundId: String
    let timestamp: String
    let hole: Int
    let kind: String
    let payload: [String: JSONValue]

    var isSyncMarker: Bool { kind == "sync_marker" }

}

private struct LegacyRevisionBuilder {
    let binding: LegacyMigrationBinding
    private var revisions: [String: EntityRevisionToken] = [:]
    private var contributors: [String: [String]] = [:]

    mutating func convert(_ legacy: LegacyEvent, clientSequence: Int) throws -> DomainRoundEvent {
        func required(_ key: String) throws -> JSONValue {
            guard let value = legacy.payload[key] else { throw LegacyConversionError.invalidPayload }
            return value
        }
        let mapped: (RoundEventKind, String, [String: JSONValue], String)
        switch legacy.kind {
        case "score": mapped = (.holeScoreSet, "round:\(legacy.roundId):hole:\(legacy.hole):score", ["hole": .integer(Int64(legacy.hole)), "strokes": try required("strokes")], "strokes")
        case "putt": mapped = (.puttsSet, "round:\(legacy.roundId):hole:\(legacy.hole):putts", ["hole": .integer(Int64(legacy.hole)), "putts": try required("putts")], "putts")
        case "penalty": mapped = (.penaltiesSet, "round:\(legacy.roundId):hole:\(legacy.hole):penalties", ["hole": .integer(Int64(legacy.hole)), "penalties": try required("penalties")], "penalties")
        default: mapped = (RoundEventKind(rawValue: "legacy_v1_\(legacy.kind)"), "legacy:\(legacy.eventId)", legacy.payload, "")
        }
        let prior = revisions[mapped.1] ?? try Self.absent(scopeId: mapped.1)
        let event = DomainRoundEvent(
            eventId: legacy.eventId, originDeviceId: "legacy-ios", originEpoch: "legacy-ios-v1", clientSequence: clientSequence,
            ownerAccountId: binding.ownerAccountId, subjectPlayerId: binding.subjectPlayerId, actorId: binding.subjectPlayerId,
            roundId: legacy.roundId, streamSubject: .roundIncarnation(binding.roundIncarnationId), roundIntentId: binding.roundIntentId,
            snapshotId: binding.snapshotId, roundSemanticBindingHash: binding.semanticBindingHash,
            kind: mapped.0, entityRef: mapped.1, payload: mapped.2, causationId: contributors[mapped.1]?.last,
            baseEntityRevision: mapped.3.isEmpty ? nil : prior, occurredAt: Self.normalized(legacy.timestamp)
        )
        if !mapped.3.isEmpty {
            let ids = (contributors[mapped.1] ?? []) + [try event.eventIdentity()]
            contributors[mapped.1] = ids
            revisions[mapped.1] = EntityRevisionToken(
                scopeId: mapped.1, reducerVersion: "round-reducer-v2", canonicalOrdinal: prior.canonicalOrdinal + 1,
                entityProjectionHash: try TypedID.make(
                    domain: "EntityProjection/v1",
                    value: .object(["value": try required(mapped.3)])
                ),
                contributingEventSetHash: try TypedID.make(domain: "ContributingEventSet/v1", value: .object(["eventIds": .array(ids.sorted().map(JSONValue.string))])),
                provisionalFlag: true
            )
        }
        return event
    }

    private static func absent(scopeId: String) throws -> EntityRevisionToken {
        EntityRevisionToken(
            scopeId: scopeId, reducerVersion: "round-reducer-v2", canonicalOrdinal: 0,
            entityProjectionHash: try TypedID.make(domain: "EntityProjection/v1", value: .object(["value": .null])),
            contributingEventSetHash: try TypedID.make(domain: "ContributingEventSet/v1", value: .object(["eventIds": .array([])])),
            provisionalFlag: true
        )
    }

    private static func normalized(_ value: String) -> String {
        let fractional = ISO8601DateFormatter(); fractional.formatOptions = [.withInternetDateTime, .withFractionalSeconds]
        let whole = ISO8601DateFormatter(); whole.formatOptions = [.withInternetDateTime]
        guard let date = fractional.date(from: value) ?? whole.date(from: value) else { return value }
        let output = ISO8601DateFormatter(); output.formatOptions = [.withInternetDateTime, .withFractionalSeconds]
        output.timeZone = TimeZone(secondsFromGMT: 0)
        return output.string(from: date)
    }
}

private enum LegacyConversionError: Error {
    case invalidPayload
}

private enum LegacyReadRecord {
    case event(LegacyEvent, sourceLine: Int, raw: Data)
    case malformed(sourceLine: Int, raw: Data)
}

private enum LegacyEventReader {
    static func read(url: URL) throws -> [LegacyReadRecord] {
        let text = try String(contentsOf: url, encoding: .utf8)
        return text.split(separator: "\n", omittingEmptySubsequences: true).enumerated().map { offset, line in
            let raw = Data(line.utf8)
            do {
                return .event(try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(LegacyEvent.self, from: raw), sourceLine: offset + 1, raw: raw)
            } catch {
                return .malformed(sourceLine: offset + 1, raw: raw)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```swift
// AICaddieDomain API used by both storage-v1 and events.jsonl migration;
// MigrationDeadLetter itself is part of Task 11's complete DomainLedgerStateV2.
public extension DomainLedgerStore {
    func recordMigrationDeadLetter(
        sourceLine: Int = 0,
        eventId: String?,
        roundId: String?,
        reasonCode: String,
        raw: Data
    ) throws {
        let row = try MigrationDeadLetter.make(
            sourceLine: sourceLine,
            eventId: eventId,
            roundId: roundId,
            reasonCode: reasonCode,
            raw: raw
        )
        try transaction { state in
            guard !state.migrationDeadLetters.contains(where: { $0.id == row.id }) else { return }
            state.migrationDeadLetters.append(row)
        }
    }

    func importMigrationBatch(
        events: [DomainRoundEvent],
        deadLetters: [MigrationDeadLetter],
        marker: String
    ) throws {
        try transaction { state in
            if state.migrationMarkers.contains(marker) { return }
            for event in events { try appendValidated(event, to: &state) }
            let known = Set(state.migrationDeadLetters.map(\.id))
            state.migrationDeadLetters.append(contentsOf: deadLetters.filter { !known.contains($0.id) })
            state.migrationMarkers.insert(marker)
        }
    }

    func migrationDeadLetters() throws -> [MigrationDeadLetter] {
        try locked { try loadV2().migrationDeadLetters.sorted { $0.sourceLine < $1.sourceLine } }
    }
}
```

`MigrationDeadLetter/v1` 加入 canonical object registry，included fields 为 `sourceLine/eventId/roundId/reasonCode/rawBase64`。`OfflineStoreTests` 用 Domain ledger 已有的 atomic-replace fault injector 在 batch replace 前抛错，重启后断言 event/dead-letter/marker 均为 0；关闭 fault 后重跑得到恰好 2 events、3 个唯一 dead letters 和 1 marker；replace 后注入的进程终止重启则直接读取完整 batch，不会重复 dead letter。

`LiveRoundEvent` 变为 v1 adapter；所有新写入由 `LiveRoundEventBuilder` 直接创建 `DomainRoundEvent`，生成/持久化 originEpoch、clientSequence 和 RoundSemanticBindingHash。

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddie/Services/ConsumerEpochStore.swift
import Foundation

final class ConsumerEpochStore {
    private let url: URL

    init(url: URL) throws {
        self.url = url
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: url.deletingLastPathComponent(), withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        if !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) {
            try Data(UUID().uuidString.lowercased().utf8).write(to: url, options: .atomic)
        }
    }

    func current() throws -> String {
        let value = try String(contentsOf: url, encoding: .utf8)
        guard UUID(uuidString: value) != nil, value == value.lowercased() else {
            throw DomainLedgerError.bootstrapRequired
        }
        return value
    }

    func rotateAfterLocalReplicaReset() throws -> String {
        let value = UUID().uuidString.lowercased()
        try Data(value.utf8).write(to: url, options: .atomic)
        return value
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddie/Services/DeviceRequestSigning.swift
import CryptoKit
import Foundation
import AICaddieDomain

public enum DeviceRequestAudience: String, Sendable {
    case eventIngest = "round-ledger-v2"
    case courseService = "course-service-v1"
}

public struct DeviceSignedHeaders: Sendable, Equatable {
    public let values: [String: String]
}

public enum DeviceRequestHeaderContract {
    public static let proofHeaderNames = Set([
        "x-ai-caddie-device-id",
        "x-ai-caddie-device-credential-id",
        "x-ai-caddie-device-nonce",
        "x-ai-caddie-device-issued-at",
        "x-ai-caddie-content-sha256",
        "x-ai-caddie-device-signature",
    ])
    public static let forwardedHeaderNames = proofHeaderNames.union([
        "content-type", "idempotency-key",
    ])

    public static func hasExactNames(
        _ headers: [String: String],
        expected: Set<String>
    ) -> Bool {
        let normalized = headers.keys.map { $0.lowercased() }
        return normalized.count == Set(normalized).count
            && Set(normalized) == expected
            && !normalized.contains("authorization")
    }
}

public struct SignedDeviceHTTPRequest: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
    public let method: String
    public let target: String
    public let body: Data
    public let headers: [String: String]
}

public protocol DeviceRequestSigner: Sendable {
    func sign(
        method: String,
        target: String,
        body: Data,
        audience: DeviceRequestAudience
    ) throws -> DeviceSignedHeaders
}

public final class Ed25519DeviceRequestSigner: DeviceRequestSigner, @unchecked Sendable {
    private let privateKey: Curve25519.Signing.PrivateKey
    private let accountId: String
    private let credentialId: String
    private let deviceId: String
    private let clock: () -> Date
    private let nonce: () -> Data

    public init(
        privateKey: Curve25519.Signing.PrivateKey,
        accountId: String,
        credentialId: String,
        deviceId: String,
        clock: @escaping () -> Date = Date.init,
        nonce: @escaping () -> Data = { Data((0..<32).map { _ in UInt8.random(in: 0...255) }) }
    ) {
        self.privateKey = privateKey
        self.accountId = accountId
        self.credentialId = credentialId
        self.deviceId = deviceId
        self.clock = clock
        self.nonce = nonce
    }

    public func sign(
        method: String,
        target: String,
        body: Data,
        audience: DeviceRequestAudience
    ) throws -> DeviceSignedHeaders {
        let issued = ISO8601DateFormatter()
        issued.formatOptions = [.withInternetDateTime, .withFractionalSeconds]
        issued.timeZone = TimeZone(secondsFromGMT: 0)
        let issuedAt = issued.string(from: clock())
            .replacingOccurrences(of: ":00Z", with: ".000Z")
        let nonceData = nonce()
        guard nonceData.count == 32 else { throw DeviceSigningError.invalidNonce }
        let nonceText = nonceData.base64URLEncodedString()
        let contentHash = SHA256.hash(data: body).hexLowercased
        let canonicalTarget = try CanonicalRequestTarget.normalize(target)
        let proof: [String: String] = [
            "schema": "ai-caddie-device-request-proof-v1",
            "audience": audience.rawValue,
            "credentialId": credentialId,
            "accountId": accountId,
            "method": method.uppercased(),
            "target": canonicalTarget,
            "contentSha256": contentHash,
            "nonce": nonceText,
            "issuedAt": issuedAt,
        ]
        let proofBytes = try CanonicalJSON.data(proof)
        try GeneratedContractValidators.validateDeviceRequestProof(proofBytes)
        var signatureInput = Data("DeviceRequestProof/v1\0".utf8)
        signatureInput.append(proofBytes)
        let signature = try privateKey.signature(for: signatureInput)
        return DeviceSignedHeaders(values: [
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-ID": deviceId,
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-Credential-ID": credentialId,
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-Nonce": nonceText,
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-Issued-At": issuedAt,
            "X-AI-Caddie-Content-SHA256": contentHash,
            "X-AI-Caddie-Device-Signature": signature.base64URLEncodedString(),
        ])
    }
}

public enum DeviceSigningError: Error, Equatable { case invalidNonce }

private extension Data {
    func base64URLEncodedString() -> String {
        base64EncodedString().replacingOccurrences(of: "+", with: "-")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "/", with: "_")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "=", with: "")
    }
}

private extension SHA256.Digest {
    var hexLowercased: String { map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined() }
}
```

`URLSessionRoundSyncTransport` 必须注入 `any DeviceRequestSigner`，每次 HTTP request 都先构造最终 raw target/body，再签名；不得再接受或发送 caller-provided plain device ID。Idempotency-Key 仍由 canonical body digest 稳定生成，nonce/signature 每次 retry更新。`CanonicalRequestTargetTests` 与 `DeviceRequestSigningTests` 都读取 `device_request_proof_golden.json`：用 fixture固定 raw private key/clock/nonce/body/target，逐字节断言 normalized target、proof九个 key、domain-prefixed signature input与 literal base64url signature，并用 Python public key验签；测试不得随机生成 key或只断言“signature非空”。改一个 path/query/body/schema/audience/prefix字节必须失败。

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieTests/DeviceRequestSigningTests.swift
import CryptoKit
import XCTest
@testable import AICaddie

private struct DeviceRequestProofGolden: Decodable {
    let privateKeyRawBase64: String
    let bodyBase64: String
    let accountId: String
    let credentialId: String
    let deviceId: String
    let unixTimeSeconds: TimeInterval
    let nonceRawBase64: String
    let method: String
    let rawTarget: String
    let normalizedTarget: String
    let signatureBase64URL: String
    let expectedHeaders: [String: String]
}

func testDeviceProofMatchesCrossLanguageGoldenBytes() throws {
    let fixtureURL = Bundle.module.url(
        forResource: "device_request_proof_golden",
        withExtension: "json",
        subdirectory: "Fixtures"
    )!
    let fixture = try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
        DeviceRequestProofGolden.self,
        from: Data(contentsOf: fixtureURL)
    )
    let key = try Curve25519.Signing.PrivateKey(
        rawRepresentation: Data(base64Encoded: fixture.privateKeyRawBase64)!
    )
    let body = Data(base64Encoded: fixture.bodyBase64)!
    let signer = Ed25519DeviceRequestSigner(
        privateKey: key,
        accountId: fixture.accountId,
        credentialId: fixture.credentialId,
        deviceId: fixture.deviceId,
        clock: { Date(timeIntervalSince1970: fixture.unixTimeSeconds) },
        nonce: { Data(base64Encoded: fixture.nonceRawBase64)! }
    )
    let headers = try signer.sign(
        method: fixture.method,
        target: fixture.rawTarget,
        body: body,
        audience: .eventIngest
    ).values
    XCTAssertEqual(try CanonicalRequestTarget.normalize(fixture.rawTarget), fixture.normalizedTarget)
    XCTAssertEqual(headers, fixture.expectedHeaders)
    XCTAssertEqual(headers["X-AI-Caddie-Device-Signature"], fixture.signatureBase64URL)
}
```
